verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭੇਟਿਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖੀ ਹੋਤ ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sukh saagar prabh bheTiaai naanak sukhee hot ih jeeau ||1||
verses.translation: Meeting with God, the Ocean of Peace, O Nanak, this soul becomes happy. ||1||
Chhant:

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਬ ਹੋਵੈ ਭਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sukh saagar prabh paieeaai jab hovai bhaago raam ||
verses.translation: One finds God, the Ocean of Peace, when destiny is activated.

verses.original: ਮਾਨਨਿ ਮਾਨੁ ਵਞਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: maanan maan van(j)aieeaai har charanee laago raam ||
verses.translation: Abandoning the distinctions of honor and dishonor, grasp the Feet of the Lord.

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਚਾਤੁਰੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਤਿਆਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: chhodd siaanap chaaturee dhuramat budh tiaago raam ||
verses.translation: Renounce cleverness and trickery, and forsake your evil-minded intellect.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਉ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਹਾਗੋ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak pau saranaiee raam rai thir hoi suhaago raam ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, seek the Sanctuary of the Sovereign Lord, Your King, and your marriage will be permanent and stable. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਜਿ ਕਤ ਲਾਗੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: so prabh taj kat laageeaai jis bin mar jaieeaai raam ||
verses.translation: Why forsake God, and attach yourself to another? Without the Lord, you cannot even live.

verses.original: ਲਾਜ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਬਿਰਮਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: laaj na aavai agiaan matee dhurajan biramaieeaai raam ||
verses.translation: The ignorant fool does not feel any shame; the evil man wanders around deluded.

verses.original: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਹੁ ਕਤ ਠਹਰਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: patit paavan prabh tiaag kare kahu kat Thaharaieeaai raam ||
verses.translation: God is the Purifier of sinners; if he forsakes God, tell me, where he can find a place of rest?

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਕੀ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak bhagat bhaau kar dhiaal kee jeevan padh paieeaai raam ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by loving devotional worship of the Merciful Lord, he attains the state of eternal life. ||2||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੋਪਾਲੁ ਨ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਬਲਿ ਗਈਏ ਦੁਹਚਾਰਣਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: sree gopaal na uchareh bal gie'ee dhuhachaaran rasanaa raam ||
verses.translation: May that vicious tongue that does not chant the Name of the Great Lord of the World, be burnt.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਨਹ ਸੇਵਹੀ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਕ ਗ੍ਰਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: prabh bhagat vachhal neh sevahee kaiaa kaak grasanaa raam ||
verses.translation: One who does not serve God, the Lover of His devotees, shall have his body eaten by crows.

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਮੋਹੀ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਜਾਣਹੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਬਸਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: bhram mohee dhookh na jaanahee koT jonee basanaa raam ||
verses.translation: Enticed by doubt, he does not understand the pain it brings; he wanders through millions of incarnations.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਜਿ ਚਾਹਨਾ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਮ ਭਸਮਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak bin har avar j chaahanaa bisaTaa kiram bhasamaa raam ||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, if you desire anything other than the Lord, you shall be consumed, like a maggot in manure. ||3||

verses.original: ਲਾਇ ਬਿਰਹੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਸੰਗੇ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: lai birahu bhagava(n)t sa(n)ge hoi mil bairaagan raam ||
verses.translation: Embrace love for the Lord God, and in detachment, unite with Him.

verses.original: ਚੰਦਨ ਚੀਰ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਰਸਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਿਆਗਨਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dhan cheer suga(n)dh rasaa haumai bikh tiaagan raam ||
verses.translation: Give up your sandalwood oil, expensive clothes, perfumes, tasty flavors and the poison of egotism.

verses.original: ਈਤ ਊਤ ਨਹ ਡੋਲੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਜਾਗਨਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: e'eet uoot neh ddoleeaai har sevaa jaagan raam ||
verses.translation: Do not waver this way or that, but remain wakeful in the service of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਾ ਅਟਲ ਸੁਹਾਗਨਿ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੧॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak jin prabh paiaa aapanaa saa aTal suhaagan raam ||4||1||4||
verses.translation: O Nanak, she who has obtained her God, is a happy soul-bride forever. ||4||1||4||
Bilaaval, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਵਡਭਾਗੀਹੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: har khojahu vaddabhaageeho mil saadhoo sa(n)ge raam ||
verses.translation: Seek the Lord, O fortunate ones, and join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗੋਵਿਦ ਸਦ ਗਾਈਅਹਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gun govidh sadh gaie'eeh paarabraham kai ra(n)ge raam ||
verses.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe forever, imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਪਾਈਅਹਿ ਫਲ ਮੰਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: so prabh sadh hee seveeaai paie'eeh fal ma(n)ge raam ||
verses.translation: Serving God forever, you shall obtain the fruitful rewards you desire.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਜਪਿ ਅਨਤ ਤਰੰਗੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak prabh saranaagatee jap anat tara(n)ge raam ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, seek the Sanctuary of God; meditate on the Lord, and ride the many waves of the mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: eik til prabhoo na veesarai jin sabh kichh dheenaa raam ||
verses.translation: I shall not forget God, even for an instant; He has blessed me with everything.

verses.original: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਮੇਲਾਵੜਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਚੀਨੑਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: vaddabhaagee melaavaRaa gurmukh pir cheen(h)aa raam ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I have met Him; as Gurmukh, I contemplate my Husband Lord.

verses.original: ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਤਮ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਲੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: baeh pakaR tam te kaaddiaa kar apunaa leenaa raam ||
verses.translation: Holding me by the arm, He has lifted me up and pulled me out of the darkness, and made me His own.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੀਵੈ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਮਨੁ ਸੀਨਾ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naam japat naanak jeevai seetal man seenaa raam ||2||
verses.translation: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Nanak lives; his mind and heart are cooled and soothed. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਹਿ ਸਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa gun tere keh sakau prabh a(n)tarajaamee raam ||
verses.translation: What virtues of Yours can I speak, O God, O Searcher of hearts?

verses.original: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੈ ਭਏ ਪਾਰਗਰਾਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: simar simar naarainai bhe paaragaraamee raam ||
verses.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, I have crossed over to the other shore.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਸਭ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaavat govi(n)dh ke sabh ichh pujaamee raam ||
verses.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, all my desires are fulfilled.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰੇ ਸਭਹੂ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਾਮ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak udhare jap hare sabhahoo kaa suaamee raam ||3||
verses.translation: Nanak is saved, meditating on the Lord, the Lord and Master of all. ||3||

verses.original: ਰਸ ਭਿੰਨਿਅੜੇ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਮ ਸੰਗੇ ਸੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਨੀਕੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: ras bhi(n)niaRe apune raam sa(n)ge se loin neeke raam ||
verses.translation: Sublime are those eyes, which are drenched with the Love of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੇਖਤ ਇਛਾ ਪੁੰਨੀਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਜਨ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: prabh pekhat ichhaa pu(n)neeaa mil saajan jee ke raam ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon God, my desires are fulfilled; I have met the Lord, the Friend of my soul.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਫੀਕੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat ras har paiaa bikhiaa ras feeke raam ||
verses.translation: I have obtained the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Love, and now the taste of corruption is insipid and tasteless to me.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮੀਕੇ ਰਾਮ ॥੪॥੨॥੫॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak jal jaleh samaiaa jotee jot meeke raam ||4||2||5||9||
verses.translation: O Nanak, as water mingles with water, my light has merged into the Light. ||4||2||5||9||
Vaar Of Bilaaval, Fourth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਉਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਗਾਵਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਦੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਰਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: har utam har prabh gaaviaa kar naadh bilaaval raag ||
verses.translation: I sing of the sublime Lord, the Lord God, in the melody of Raag Bilaaval.

verses.original: ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਭਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: aupadhes guroo sun ma(n)niaa dhur masatak pooraa bhaag ||
verses.translation: Hearing the Guru's Teachings, I obey them; this is the pre-ordained destiny written upon my forehead.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh dhinas rain gun ucharai har har har ur liv laag ||
verses.translation: All day and night, I chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har; within my heart, I am lovingly attuned to Him.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਖਿੜਿਆ ਹਰਿਆ ਬਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh tan man hariaa hoiaa man khiRiaa hariaa baag ||
verses.translation: My body and mind are totally rejuvenated, and the garden of my mind has blossomed forth in lush abundance.

verses.original: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਗੁਰ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਚਰਾਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: agiaan a(n)dheraa miT giaa gur chaanan giaan charaag ||
verses.translation: The darkness of ignorance has been dispelled, with the light of the lamp of the Guru's wisdom. Servant Nanak lives by beholding the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਗੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak jeevai dhekh har ik nimakh ghaRee mukh laag ||1||
verses.translation: Let me behold Your face, for a moment, even an instant! ||1||
Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਕੀਜੀਐ ਜਬ ਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval tab hee keejeeaai jab mukh hovai naam ||
verses.translation: Be happy and sing in Bilaaval, when the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is in your mouth.

verses.original: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਜਾ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: raag naadh sabadh sohane jaa laagai sahaj dhiaan ||
verses.translation: The melody and music, and the Word of the Shabad are beautiful, when one focuses his meditation on the celestial Lord.

verses.original: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਛੋਡਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: raag naadh chhodd har seveeaai taa dharageh paieeaai maan ||
verses.translation: So leave behind the melody and music, and serve the Lord; then, you shall obtain honor in the Court of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh braham beechaareeaai chookai man abhimaan ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, as Gurmukh, contemplate God, and rid your mind of egotistical pride. ||2||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: too har prabh aap aga(n)m hai sabh tudh upaiaa ||
verses.translation: O Lord God, You Yourself are inaccessible; You formed everything.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: too aape aap varatadhaa sabh jagat sabaiaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are totally permeating and pervading the entire universe.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਐ ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: tudh aape taaRee laieeaai aape gun gaiaa ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are absorbed in the state of deep meditation; You Yourself sing Your Glorious Praises.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਭਗਤਹੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har dhiaavahu bhagatahu dhinas raat a(n)t le chhaddaiaa ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord, O devotees, day and night; He shall deliver you in the end.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin seviaa tin sukh paiaa har naam samaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Those who serve the Lord, find peace; they are absorbed in the Name of the Lord. ||1||
Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai bilaaval na hoviee manmukh thai na pai ||
verses.translation: In the love of duality, the happiness of Bilaaval does not come; the self-willed manmukh finds no place of rest.

verses.original: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: paakha(n)dd bhagat na hoviee paarabraham na paiaa jai ||
verses.translation: Through hypocrisy, devotional worship does not come, and the Supreme Lord God is not found.

verses.original: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manahaTh karam kamaavane thai na koiee pai ||
verses.translation: By stubborn-mindedly performing religious rituals, no one obtains the approval of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh aap beechaareeaai vichahu aap gavai ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands himself, and eradicates self-conceit from within.

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: aape aap paarabraham hai paarabraham vasiaa man aai ||
verses.translation: He Himself is the Supreme Lord God; the Supreme Lord God comes to dwell in his mind.

verses.original: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਕਟਿਆ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ja(n)man maranaa kaTiaa jotee jot milai ||1||
verses.translation: Birth and death are erased, and his light blends with the Light. ||1||
Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਕਰਿਹੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਪਿਆਰਿਹੋ ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: bilaaval karih tum(h) piaariho ekas siau liv lai ||
verses.translation: Be happy in Bilaaval, O my beloveds, and embrace love for the One Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟੀਐ ਸਚੇ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran dhukh kaTeeaai sache rahai samai ||
verses.translation: The pains of birth and death shall be eradicated, and you shall remain absorbed in the True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa bilaaval ana(n)dh hai je chaleh satigur bhai ||
verses.translation: You shall be blissful forever in Bilaaval, if you walk in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ ਬਹਿ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gatee beh bhaau kar sadhaa har ke gun gai ||
verses.translation: Sitting in the Saints' Congregation, sing with love the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak se jan sohane j gurmukh mel milai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, beautiful are those humble beings, who, as Gurmukh, are united in the Lord's Union. ||2||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਸੋ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabhanaa jeeaa vich har aap so bhagataa kaa mit har ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself is within all beings. The Lord is the friend of His devotees.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੈ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਘਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh koiee har kai vas bhagataa kai ana(n)dh ghar ||
verses.translation: Everyone is under the Lord's control; in the home of the devotees there is bliss.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਕਾ ਮੇਲੀ ਸਰਬਤ ਸਉ ਨਿਸੁਲ ਜਨ ਟੰਗ ਧਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har bhagataa kaa melee sarabat sau nisul jan Ta(n)g dhar ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the friend and companion of His devotees; all His humble servants stretch out and sleep in peace.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਖਸਮੁ ਸੋ ਭਗਤ ਜਨ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har sabhanaa kaa hai khasam so bhagat jan chit kar ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Lord and Master of all; O humble devotee, remember Him.

verses.original: ਤੁਧੁ ਅਪੜਿ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਸਭ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਪਵੈ ਝੜਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tudh apaR koi na sakai sabh jhakh jhakh pavai jhaR ||2||
verses.translation: No one can equal You, Lord. Those who try, struggle and die in frustration. ||2||
Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦਹਿ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣਾ ਜੇ ਚਲਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: braham bi(n)dheh te braahamanaa je chaleh satigur bhai ||
verses.translation: He alone knows God, and he alone is a Brahmin, who walks in harmony with the Will of the True Guru.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jin kai hiradhai har vasai haumai rog gavai ||
verses.translation: One whose heart is filled with the Lord, is freed of egotism and disease.

verses.original: ਗੁਣ ਰਵਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਹਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gun raveh gun sa(n)graheh jotee jot milai ||
verses.translation: He chants the Lord's Praises, gathers virtue, and his light merges into the Light.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eis jug meh virale braahaman braham bi(n)dheh chit lai ||
verses.translation: How rare are those Brahmins who, in this age, come to know God, by lovingly focusing their consciousness on Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jin(h) kau nadhar kare har sachaa se naam rahe liv lai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are blessed by the Lord's Glance of Grace, remain lovingly attuned to the Name of the True Lord. ||1||
Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਕੀਤੀਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee sev na keeteeaa sabadh na lago bhaau ||
verses.translation: One who does not serve the True Guru, and who does not love the Word of the Shabad,

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ ਅਤਿ ਦੀਰਘੁ ਬਹੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: haumai rog kamaavanaa at dheeragh bahu suaau ||
verses.translation: earns the very painful disease of egotism; he is so very selfish.

verses.original: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: manahaTh karam kamaavane fir fir jonee pai ||
verses.translation: Acting stubborn-mindedly, he is reincarnated over and over again.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh janam safal hai jis no aape le milai ||
verses.translation: The birth of the Gurmukh is fruitful and auspicious. The Lord unites him with Himself.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee nadhar kare taa naam dhan palai pai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, when the Merciful Lord grants His Mercy, one obtains the wealth of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਭ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: sabh vaddiaaieeaa har naam vich har gurmukh dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: All glorious greatness is in the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਮੰਗੀਐ ਸਾਈ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: j vasat ma(n)geeaai saiee paieeaai je naam chit laieeaai ||
verses.translation: One obtains all that he asks for, if he keeps his consciousness focused on the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਹਜ ਗਲ ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਕੀਚੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਸਿ ਤਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: guhaj gal jeea kee keechai satiguroo paas taa sarab sukh paieeaai ||
verses.translation: If he tells the secrets of his soul to the True Guru, then he finds absolute peace.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: gur pooraa har upadhes dhei sabh bhukh leh jaieeaai ||
verses.translation: When the Perfect Guru bestows the Lord's Teachings, then all hunger departs.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jis poorab hovai likhiaa so har gun gaieeaai ||3||
verses.translation: One who is blessed with such pre-ordained destiny, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||
Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਖਾਲੀ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur te khaalee ko nahee merai prabh mel milaae ||
verses.translation: No one goes away empty-handed from the True Guru; He unites me in Union with my God.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੇਹਾ ਕੋ ਇਛੇ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kaa dharasan safal hai jehaa ko ichhe tehaa fal paae ||
verses.translation: Fruitful is the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the True Guru; through it, one obtains whatever fruitful rewards he desires.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh a(n)mrit hai sabh tirasanaa bhukh gavaae ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is Ambrosial Nectar. It banishes all hunger and thirst.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: har ras pee sa(n)tokh hoaa sach vasiaa man aae ||
verses.translation: Drinking in the sublime essence of the Lord brings contentment; the True Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sach dhiaai amaraa padh paiaa anahadh sabadh vajaae ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the True Lord, the status of immortality is obtained; the Unstruck Word of the Shabad vibrates and resounds.

verses.original: ਸਚੋ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਪਸਰਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sacho dheh dhis pasariaa gur kai sahaj subhaae ||
verses.translation: The True Lord is pervading in the ten directions; through the Guru, this is intuitively known.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਛਪਹਿ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੇ ਛਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jin a(n)dhar sach hai se jan chhapeh na kisai dhe chhapaae ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those humble beings who have the Truth deep within, are never hidden, even if others try to hide them. ||1||
Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa te har paieeaai jaa kau nadhar karei ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, one finds the Lord, when the Lord blesses him with His Glance of Grace.

verses.original: ਮਾਨਸ ਤੇ ਦੇਵਤੇ ਭਏ ਸਚੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: maanas te dhevate bhe sachee bhagat jis dhei ||
verses.translation: Human beings become angels, when the Lord blesses them with true devotional worship.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਚੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai maar milaian gur kai sabadh suchei ||
verses.translation: Conquering egotism, they are blended with the Lord; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are purified.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sahaje mil rahe naam vaddiaaiee dhei ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, they remain merged with the Lord; they are blessed with the glorious greatness of the Naam. ||2||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਆਪਿ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur satigur vich naavai kee vaddee vaddiaaiee har karatai aap vadhaiee ||
verses.translation: Within the Guru, the True Guru, is the glorious greatness of the Name. The Creator Lord Himself has magnified it.

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਸਿਖ ਸਭਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਵੇਖਿ ਜੀਵਨਿੑ ਓਨੑਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sevak sikh sabh vekh vekh jeevani(h) on(h)aa a(n)dhar hiradhai bhaiee ||
verses.translation: All His servants and Sikhs live by gazing, gazing upon it. It is pleasing to their hearts deep within.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਦੁਸਟ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੇਖਿ ਨ ਸਕਨਿ ਓਨੑਾ ਪਰਾਇਆ ਭਲਾ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak dhusaT vaddiaaiee vekh na sakan on(h)aa paraiaa bhalaa na sukhaiee ||
verses.translation: The slanderers and evil-doers cannot see this glorious greatness; they do not appreciate the goodness of others.

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਝਖ ਮਾਰੀ ਜਾ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa hovai kis hee kee jhakh maaree jaa sache siau ban aaiee ||
verses.translation: What can be achieved by anyone babbling? The Guru is in love with the True Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿ ਗਲ ਕਰਤੇ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ਸਭ ਝਖਿ ਝਖਿ ਮਰੈ ਲੋਕਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: j gal karate bhaavai saa nit nit chaRai savaiee sabh jhakh jhakh marai lokaiee ||4||
verses.translation: That which is pleasing to the Creator Lord, increases day by day, while all the people babble uselessly. ||4||
Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਏਹ ਆਸਾ ਦੂਜੇ ਭਾਵ ਕੀ ਜੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: dhirag eh aasaa dhooje bhaav kee jo moh maiaa chit laae ||
verses.translation: Cursed are the hopes in the love of duality; they tie the consciousness to love and attachment to Maya.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਲੑਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: har sukh pal(h)r tiaagiaa naam visaar dhukh paae ||
verses.translation: One who forsakes the peace of the Lord in exchange for straw, and forgets the Naam, suffers in pain.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh agiaanee a(n)dhule janam mareh fir aavai jaae ||
verses.translation: The ignorant self-willed manmukhs are blind. They are born, only to die again, and continue coming and going.

verses.original: ਕਾਰਜ ਸਿਧਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਨੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: kaaraj sidh na hovanee a(n)t giaa pachhutaae ||
verses.translation: Their affairs are not resolved, and in the end, they depart, regretting and repenting.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: jis karam hovai tis satigur milai so har har naam dhiaae ||
verses.translation: One who is blessed with the Lord's Grace, meets the True Guru; he alone meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿੑ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam rate jan sadhaa sukh paini(h) jan naanak tin bal jaae ||1||
verses.translation: Imbued with the Naam, the humble servants of the Lord find a lasting peace; servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||1||
Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਜਗਿ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: aasaa manasaa jag mohanee jin mohiaa sa(n)saar ||
verses.translation: Hope and desire entice the world; they entice the whole universe.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਚੀਰੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੈ ਜੇਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: sabh ko jam ke cheere vich hai jetaa sabh aakaar ||
verses.translation: Everyone, and all that has been created, is under the domination of Death.

verses.original: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੀ ਜਮੁ ਲਗਦਾ ਸੋ ਉਬਰੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: hukamee hee jam lagadhaa so ubarai jis bakhasai karataar ||
verses.translation: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, Death seizes the mortal; he alone is saved, whom the Creator Lord forgives.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਾਂ ਤਰੈ ਜਾ ਛੋਡੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak gur parasaadhee eh man taa(n) tarai jaa chhoddai aha(n)kaar ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, this mortal swims across, if he abandons his ego.

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਾਰੇ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aasaa manasaa maare niraas hoi gur sabadhee veechaar ||2||
verses.translation: Conquer hope and desire, and remain unattached; contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਈਐ ਜਗਤ ਮਹਿ ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jithai jaieeaai jagat meh tithai har saiee ||
verses.translation: Wherever I go in this world, I see the Lord there.

verses.original: ਅਗੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਨਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: agai sabh aape varatadhaa har sachaa niaaiee ||
verses.translation: In the world hereafter as well, the Lord, the True Judge Himself, is pervading and permeating everywhere.

verses.original: ਕੂੜਿਆਰਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਹ ਫਿਟਕੀਅਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: kooRiaaraa ke muh fiTake'eeh sach bhagat vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: The faces of the false are cursed, while the true devotees are blessed with glorious greatness.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚਾ ਨਿਆਉ ਹੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਛਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sach saahib sachaa niaau hai sir ni(n)dhak chhaiee ||
verses.translation: True is the Lord and Master, and true is His justice. The heads of the slanderers are covered with ashes.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: jan naanak sach araadhiaa gurmukh sukh paiee ||5||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak worships the True Lord in adoration; as Gurmukh, he finds peace. ||5||
Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: poorai bhaag satigur paieeaai je har prabh bakhas karei ||
verses.translation: By perfect destiny, one finds the True Guru, if the Lord God grants forgiveness.

verses.original: ਓਪਾਵਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਓਪਾਉ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: opaavaa sir opaau hai naau paraapat hoi ||
verses.translation: Of all efforts, the best effort is to attain the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar seetal saa(n)t hai hiradhai sadhaa sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: It brings a cooling, soothing tranquility deep within the heart, and eternal peace.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਪੈਨੑਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit khaanaa pain(h)naa naanak nai vaddiaaiee hoi ||1||
verses.translation: Then, one eats and wears the Ambrosial Nectar; O Nanak, through the Name, comes glorious greatness. ||1||
Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਏ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਪਾਇਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: e man gur kee sikh sun paieh gunee nidhaan ||
verses.translation: O mind, listening to the Guru's Teachings, you shall obtain the treasure of virtue.

verses.original: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sukhadhaataa terai man vasai haumai jai abhimaan ||
verses.translation: The Giver of peace shall dwell in your mind; you shall be rid of egotism and pride.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak nadharee paieeaai a(n)mrit gunee nidhaan ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, by His Grace, one is blessed with the Ambrosial Nectar of the treasure of virtue. ||2||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਤਨੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ਸਾਹ ਰਾਜੇ ਖਾਨ ਉਮਰਾਵ ਸਿਕਦਾਰ ਹਹਿ ਤਿਤਨੇ ਸਭਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: jitane paatisaeh saeh raaje khaan umaraav sikadhaar heh titane sabh har ke ke'ee ||
verses.translation: The kings, emperors, rulers, lords, nobles and chiefs, are all created by the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਓਇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਅਰਥੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh har karaavai su oi kareh sabh har ke arathe'ee ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Lord causes them to do, they do; they are all beggars, dependent on the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਵਲਿ ਹੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਭਿ ਵਰਨ ਚਾਰੇ ਖਾਣੀ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਗੋਲੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਗੈ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣ ਕਉ ਦੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: so aaisaa har sabhanaa kaa prabh satigur kai val hai tin sabh varan chaare khaanee sabh sirasaT gole kar satigur agai kaar kamaavan kau dhe'ee ||
verses.translation: Such is God, the Lord of all; He is on the True Guru's side. All castes and social classes, the four sources of creation, and the whole universe are slaves of the True Guru; God makes them work for Him.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੇ ਕੀ ਐਸੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੀ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੂਤ ਸਭਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: har seve kee aaisee vaddiaaiee dhekhahu har sa(n)tahu jin vichahu kaiaa nagaree dhusaman dhoot sabh maar kadde'ee ||
verses.translation: See the glorious greatness of serving the Lord, O Saints of the Lord; He has conquered and driven all the enemies and evil-doers out of the body-village.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਉਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਖਿ ਲੀਏ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: har har kirapaal hoaa bhagat janaa upar har aapanee kirapaa kar har aap rakh le'ee ||6||
verses.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, is Merciful to His humble devotees; granting His Grace, the Lord Himself protects and preserves them. ||6||
Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar kapaT sadhaa dhukh hai manmukh dhiaan na laagai ||
verses.translation: Fraud and hypocrisy within bring constant pain; the self-willed manmukh does not practice meditation.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh vich kaar kamaavanee dhukh varatai dhukh aagai ||
verses.translation: Suffering in pain, he does his deeds; he is immersed in pain, and he shall suffer in pain hereafter.

verses.original: ਕਰਮੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: karamee satigur bheTeeaai taa sach naam liv laagai ||
verses.translation: By his karma, he meets the True Guru, and then, he is lovingly attuned to the True Name.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak sahaje sukh hoi a(n)dharahu bhram bhau bhaagai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, he is naturally at peace; doubt and fear run away and leave him. ||1||
Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sadhaa har ra(n)g hai har kaa naau man bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh is in love with the Lord forever. The Name of the Lord is pleasing to his mind.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh vekhan bolanaa naam japat sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh beholds and speaks the Naam, the Name of the Lord; chanting the Naam, he finds peace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਤਿਮਰ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh giaan pragaasiaa timar agiaan a(n)dher chukaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the spiritual wisdom of the Gurmukh shines forth; the black darkness of ignorance is dispelled. ||2||
Third Mehla:
The filthy, foolish, self-willed manmukhs die.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh niramal har raakhiaa ur dhaar ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are immaculate and pure; they keep the Lord enshrined within their hearts.
Prays Nanak, listen, O Siblings of Destiny!
Serve the True Guru, and the filth of your ego shall be gone.

verses.original: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਧੰਧਾ ਨਿਤ ਮਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhar sa(n)saa dhookh viaape sir dha(n)dhaa nit maar ||
verses.translation: Deep within, the pain of skepticism afflicts them; their heads are constantly assaulted by worldly entanglements.

verses.original: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਸੂਤੇ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਜਾਗਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਰ ॥
verses.translit: dhoojai bhai soote kabahu na jaageh maiaa moh piaar ||
verses.translation: Asleep in the love of duality, they never wake up; they are attached to the love of Maya.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਾ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: naam na cheteh sabadh na veechaareh ih manmukh kaa beechaar ||
verses.translation: They do not remember the Name, and they do not contemplate the Word of the Shabad; this is the view of the self-willed manmukhs.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har naam na bhaiaa birathaa janam gavaiaa naanak jam maar kare khuaar ||3||
verses.translation: They do not love the Lord's Name, and they lose their life uselessly. O Nanak, the Messenger of Death attacks them, and humiliates them. ||3||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਬਖਸੀਅਨੁ ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis no har bhagat sach bakhaseean so sachaa saahu ||
verses.translation: He alone is a true king, whom the Lord blesses with true devotion.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੀ ਲੋਕੁ ਕਢਦਾ ਹੋਰਤੁ ਹਟਿ ਨ ਵਥੁ ਨ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis kee muhataajee lok kaddadhaa horat haT na vath na vesaahu ||
verses.translation: People pledge their allegiance to him; no other store stocks this merchandise, nor deals in this trade.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਸਨਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਲਏ ਵੇਮੁਖ ਭਸੁ ਪਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa kau sanamukh hovai su har raas le vemukh bhas paahu ||
verses.translation: That humble devotee who turns his face towards the Guru and becomes sunmukh, receives the Lord's wealth; the faithless baymukh, who turns his face away from the Guru, gathers only ashes.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਹਹਿ ਜਮੁ ਜਾਗਾਤੀ ਤਿਨਾ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam ke vaapaaree har bhagat heh jam jaagaatee tinaa neR na jaahu ||
verses.translation: The Lord's devotees are dealers in the Name of the Lord. The Messenger of Death, the tax-collector, does not even approach them.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਲਦਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har naam dhan ladhiaa sadhaa veparavaahu ||7||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has loaded the wealth of the Name of the Lord, who is forever independent and care-free. ||7||
Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਹੋਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eis jug meh bhagatee har dhan khaTiaa hor sabh jagat bharam bhulaiaa ||
verses.translation: In this age, the devotee earns the wealth of the Lord; all the rest of the world wanders deluded in doubt.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur parasaadhee naam man vasiaa anadhin naam dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: By Guru's Grace, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell in his mind; night and day, he meditates on the Naam.

verses.original: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਉਦਾਸ ਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bikhiaa maeh udhaas hai haumai sabadh jalaiaa ||
verses.translation: In the midst of corruption, he remains detached; through the Word of the Shabad, he burns away his ego.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਿਆ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਰੇ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਣੇਦੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: aap tariaa kul udhare dha(n)n janedhee maiaa ||
verses.translation: He crosses over, and saves his relatives as well; blessed is the mother who gave birth to him.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sahaj sukh man vasiaa sache siau liv laiaa ||
verses.translation: Peace and poise fill his mind forever, and he embraces love for the True Lord.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਭੁਲੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: brahamaa bisan mahaadheau trai gun bhule haumai moh vadhaiaa ||
verses.translation: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva wander in the three qualities, while their egotism and desire increase.

verses.original: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਿ ਪੜਿ ਮੋਨੀ ਭੁਲੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ddit paR paR monee bhule dhoojai bhai chit laiaa ||
verses.translation: The Pandits, the religious scholars and the silent sages read and debate in confusion; their consciousness is centered on the love of duality.

verses.original: ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਭੁਲੇ ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jogee ja(n)gam sa(n)niaasee bhule vin gur tat na paiaa ||
verses.translation: The Yogis, wandering pilgrims and Sanyaasees are deluded; without the Guru, they do not find the essence of reality.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਦੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh dhukhe'ee sadhaa bhram bhule tin(h)ee birathaa janam gavaiaa ||
verses.translation: The miserable self-willed manmukhs are forever deluded by doubt; they waste away their lives uselessly.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਸਮਧੇ ਜਿ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak naam rate seiee jan samadhe j aape bakhas milaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam are balanced and poised; forgiving them, the Lord blends them with Himself. ||1||
Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਸਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: naanak so saalaaheeaai jis vas sabh kichh hoi ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, praise Him, who has control over everything.

verses.original: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀਹੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tiseh sarevahu praaneeho tis bin avar na koi ||
verses.translation: Remember Him, O mortals - without Him, there is no other at all.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmukh a(n)tar man vasai sadhaa sadhaa sukh hoi ||2||
verses.translation: He dwells deep within those who are Gurmukh; forever and ever, they are at peace. ||2||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਨ ਖਟਿਓ ਸੇ ਦੇਵਾਲੀਏ ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jinee gurmukh har naam dhan na khaTio se dhevaale'ee jug maeh ||
verses.translation: Those who do not become Gurmukh and earn the wealth of the Lord's Name, are bankrupt in this age.

verses.original: ਓਇ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸਭ ਜਗਤ ਮਹਿ ਕੋਈ ਮੁਹਿ ਥੁਕ ਨ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: oi ma(n)gadhe fireh sabh jagat meh koiee muh thuk na tin kau paeh ||
verses.translation: They wander around begging all over the world, but no one even spits in their faces.

verses.original: ਪਰਾਈ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਖੋਵਨਿ ਸਗਵਾ ਭੀ ਆਪੁ ਲਖਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: paraiee bakheelee kareh aapanee parateet khovan sagavaa bhee aap lakhaeh ||
verses.translation: They gossip about others, and lose their credit, and expose themselves as well.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਚੁਗਲੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਚੁਗਲੀ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਓਇ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਥੈ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jis dhan kaaran chugalee kareh so dhan chugalee hath na aavai oi bhaavai tithai jaeh ||
verses.translation: That wealth, for which they slander others, does not come into their hands, no matter where they go.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਥਹੁ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ ਲੈ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਹੋਰ ਥੈ ਦੇਸ ਦਿਸੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sevak bhai har dhan milai tithahu karamaheen lai na sakeh hor thai dhes dhisa(n)tar har dhan naeh ||8||
verses.translation: Through loving service, the Gurmukhs receive the wealth of the Naam, but the unfortunate ones cannot receive it. This wealth is not found anywhere else, in this country or in any other. ||8||
Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh sa(n)saa mool na hoviee chi(n)taa vichahu jai ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh does not have an iota of skepticism or doubt; worries depart from within him.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh hoi su sahaje hoi kahanaa kichhoo na jai ||
verses.translation: Whatever he does, he does with grace and poise. Nothing else can be said about him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਆਖਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣੇ ਜਿ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਪੰਨੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak tin kaa aakhiaa aap sune j lian pa(n)nai pai ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord Himself hears the speech of those whom He makes His own. ||1||
Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਾਲੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaal maar manasaa maneh samaanee a(n)tar niramal naau ||
verses.translation: He conquers death, and subdues the desires of his mind; the Immaculate Name abides deep within him.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਿਆਉ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin jaagai kadhe na sovai sahaje a(n)mrit piaau ||
verses.translation: Night and day, he remains awake and aware; he never sleeps, and he intuitively drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਮੀਠਾ ਬੋਲੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: meeThaa bole a(n)mirat baanee anadhin har gun gaau ||
verses.translation: His speech is sweet, and his words are nectar; night and day, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਦੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: nij ghar vaasaa sadhaa sohadhe naanak tin miliaa sukh paau ||2||
verses.translation: He dwells in the home of his own self, and appears beautiful forever; meeting him, Nanak finds peace. ||2||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰੀ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਦੇਵਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har dhan ratan javeharee so gur har dhan har paasahu dhevaiaa ||
verses.translation: The wealth of the Lord is a jewel, a gem; the Guru has caused the Lord to grant that wealth of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਿਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਹੁ ਮੰਗਿ ਲਏ ਅਕੈ ਕੋਈ ਕਿਹੁ ਦੇਵਾਏ ਏਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜੋਰਿ ਕੀਤੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਵੰਡਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: je kisai kih dhis aavai taa koiee kih ma(n)g le akai koiee kih dhevaae eh har dhan jor keetai kisai naal na jai va(n)ddaiaa ||
verses.translation: If someone sees something, he may ask for it; or, someone may cause it to be given to him. But no one can take a share of this wealth of the Lord by force.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਧਾ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਵੰਡ ਹਥਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਤੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis no satigur naal har saradhaa laae tis har dhan kee va(n)dd hath aavai jis no karatai dhur likh paiaa ||
verses.translation: He alone obtains a share of the wealth of the Lord, who is blessed by the Creator with faith and devotion to the True Guru, according to his pre-ordained destiny.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਖਤੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਕੈ ਸੀਵ ਬੰਨੈ ਰੋਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੇ ਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਧਨ ਕੀ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਮੁਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਲਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: eis har dhan kaa koiee sareek naahee kisai kaa khat naahee kisai kai seev ba(n)nai rol naahee je ko har dhan kee bakheelee kare tis kaa muh har chahu ku(n)ddaa vich kaalaa karaiaa ||
verses.translation: No one is a share-holder in this wealth of the Lord, and no one owns any of it. It has no boundaries or borders to be disputed. If anyone speaks ill of the wealth of the Lord, his face will be blackened in the four directions.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਿਤੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਿਸੈ ਜੋਰੁ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਦਿਹੁ ਦਿਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥੯॥
verses.translit: har ke dhite naal kisai jor bakheelee na chaliee dhih dhih nit nit chaRai savaiaa ||9||
verses.translation: No one's power or slander can prevail against the gifts of the Lord; day by day they continually, continuously increase. ||9||
Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਗਤੁ ਜਲੰਦਾ ਰਖਿ ਲੈ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jagat jala(n)dhaa rakh lai aapanee kirapaa dhaar ||
verses.translation: The world is going up in flames - shower it with Your Mercy, and save it!

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਉਬਰੈ ਤਿਤੈ ਲੈਹੁ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jit dhuaarai ubarai titai laih ubaar ||
verses.translation: Save it, and deliver it, by whatever method it takes.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: satigur sukh vekhaaliaa sachaa sabadh beechaar ||
verses.translation: The True Guru has shown the way to peace, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੁਝਈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak avar na sujhiee har bin bakhasanahaar ||1||
verses.translation: Nanak knows no other than the Lord, the Forgiving Lord. ||1||
Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: haumai maiaa mohanee dhoojai lagai jai ||
verses.translation: Through egotism, fascination with Maya has trapped them in duality.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਇਹ ਮਾਰੀ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨਾ ਇਹ ਹਟਿ ਵਿਕਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naa ieh maaree na marai naa ieh haT vikai ||
verses.translation: It cannot be killed, it does not die, and it cannot be sold in a store.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਰਜਾਲੀਐ ਤਾ ਇਹ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh parajaaleeaai taa ieh vichahu jai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is burnt away, and then it departs from within.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਜਲਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: tan man hovai ujalaa naam vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: The body and mind become pure, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to dwell within the mind.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਣੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: naanak maiaa kaa maaran sabadh hai gurmukh paiaa jai ||2||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Shabad is the killer of Maya; the Gurmukh obtains it. ||2||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤੀ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਬੁਝਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee vaddiaaiee satigur dhitee dhurahu hukam bujh neesaan ||
verses.translation: The glorious greatness of the True Guru was bestowed by the True Guru; He understood this as the Insignia, the Mark of the Primal Lord's Will.

verses.original: ਪੁਤੀ ਭਾਤੀਈ ਜਾਵਾਈ ਸਕੀ ਅਗਹੁ ਪਿਛਹੁ ਟੋਲਿ ਡਿਠਾ ਲਾਹਿਓਨੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: putee bhaateeiee jaavaiee sakee agahu pichhahu Tol ddiThaa laahion sabhanaa kaa abhimaan ||
verses.translation: He tested His sons, nephews, sons-in-law and relatives, and subdued the egotistical pride of them all.

verses.original: ਜਿਥੈ ਕੋ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਿਥੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਬਖਸਿਓਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਹਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jithai ko vekhai tithai meraa satiguroo har bakhasios sabh jahaan ||
verses.translation: Wherever anyone looks, my True Guru is there; the Lord blessed Him with the whole world.

verses.original: ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਨੇ ਸੁ ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸਿਝੈ ਜਿ ਵੇਮੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਭਰਿਸਟ ਥਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: j satigur no mil ma(n)ne su halat palat sijhai j vemukh hovai su firai bharisaT thaan ||
verses.translation: One who meets with, and believes in the True Guru, is embellished here and hereafter. Whoever turns his back on the Guru and becomes baymukh, shall wander in cursed and evil places.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੈ ਵਲਿ ਹੋਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jan naanak kai val hoaa meraa suaamee har sajan purakh sujaan ||
verses.translation: My Lord and Master is on the side of servant Nanak. The All-powerful and All-knowing Lord God is my Best Friend.

verses.original: ਪਉਦੀ ਭਿਤਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਸਭਿ ਆਇ ਪਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਰੀ ਲਾਹਿਓਨੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਿਅਹੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: paudhee bhit dhekh kai sabh aai pe satigur kee pairee laahion sabhanaa kiahu manahu gumaan ||10||
verses.translation: Seeing the food being distributed, everyone came and fell at the feet of the True Guru, who cleansed the minds of all of their egotistical pride. ||10||
Shalok, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਵਾਹੇ ਕੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਕੋ ਪਾਏ ਖਲਿਹਾਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: koiee vaahe ko lunai ko paae khalihaan ||
verses.translation: One plants the seed, another harvests the crop, and still another beats the grain from the chaff.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਕੋਈ ਖਾਇ ਨਿਦਾਨਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ev na jaapiee koiee khai nidhaan ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, it is not known, who will ultimately eat the grain. ||1||
First Mehla:
He alone is carried across, within whose mind the Lord abides.
O Nanak, that alone happens, which is pleasing to His Will. ||2||
Pauree:
The Merciful Supreme Lord God has carried me across the world-ocean.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: gur poorai miharavaan bharam bhau maariaa ||
verses.translation: The compassionate perfect Guru has eradicated my doubts and fears.

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਬਿਕਰਾਲੁ ਦੂਤ ਸਭਿ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh bikaraal dhoot sabh haariaa ||
verses.translation: Unsatisfied sexual desire and unresolved anger, the horrible demons, have been totally destroyed.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam nidhaan ka(n)Th ur dhaariaa ||
verses.translation: I have enshrined the treasure of the Ambrosial Naam within my throat and heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: naanak saadhoo sa(n)g janam maran savaariaa ||11||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my birth and death have been adorned and redeemed. ||11||
Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਕੂੜੇ ਕਹਣ ਕਹੰਨਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)ee naam visaariaa kooRe kahan kaha(n)ni(h) ||
verses.translation: Those who forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are said to be false.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਤਿਨਾ ਘਰੁ ਮੁਹਨਿੑ ਹਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸੰਨਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch chor tinaa ghar muhani(h) haumai a(n)dhar sa(n)ni(h) ||
verses.translation: The five thieves plunder their homes, and egotism breaks in.

verses.original: ਸਾਕਤ ਮੁਠੇ ਦੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੰਨਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: saakat muThe dhuramatee har ras na jaana(n)ni(h) ||
verses.translation: The faithless cynics are defrauded by their own evil-mindedness; they do not know the sublime essence of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਲੁਟਾਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ ਸਿਉ ਰਚਹਿ ਰਚੰਨਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)ee a(n)mrit bharam luTaiaa bikh siau racheh racha(n)ni(h) ||
verses.translation: Those who lose the Ambrosial Nectar through doubt, remain engrossed and entangled in corruption.

verses.original: ਦੁਸਟਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਪਿਰਹੜੀ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਵਾਦੁ ਕਰੰਨਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: dhusaTaa setee pirahaRee jan siau vaadh kara(n)ni(h) ||
verses.translation: They make friends with the wicked, and argue with the humble servants of the Lord.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰਕ ਮਹਿ ਜਮਿ ਬਧੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੰਨਿੑ ॥
verses.translit: naanak saakat narak meh jam badhe dhukh saha(n)ni(h) ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the faithless cynics are bound and gagged by the Messenger of Death, and suffer agony in hell.

verses.original: ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਜਿਵ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਤਿਵੈ ਰਹੰਨਿੑ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: piaai kirat kamaavadhe jiv raakheh tivai raha(n)ni(h) ||1||
verses.translation: They act according to the karma of the actions they committed before; as the Lord keeps them, so do they live. ||1||
Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਾਣੁ ਨਿਤਾਣੇ ਤਿਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin(h)ee satigur seviaa taan nitaane tis ||
verses.translation: Those who serve the True Guru, are transformed from powerless into powerful.

verses.original: ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤਿਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: saas giraas sadhaa man vasai jam joh na sakai tis ||
verses.translation: With every breath and morsel of food, the Lord abides in their minds forever, and the Messenger of Death cannot even see them.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਕਵਲਾ ਸੇਵਕਿ ਤਿਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai har har naam ras kavalaa sevak tis ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, fills their hearts, and Maya is their servant.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਮ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਤਿਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: har dhaasaa kaa dhaas hoi param padhaarath tis ||
verses.translation: One who becomes the slave of the Lord's slaves, obtains the greatest treasure.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਸੈ ਹਉ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ਤਿਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak man tan jis prabh vasai hau sadh kurabaanai tis ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to that one, within whose mind and body God dwells.

verses.original: ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਰਸੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਤਿਸੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin(h) kau poorab likhiaa ras sa(n)t janaa siau tis ||2||
verses.translation: One who has such pre-ordained destiny, he alone is in love with the humble Saints. ||2||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਜੋ ਬੋਲੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੋ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਸੁਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: jo bole pooraa satiguroo so paramesar suniaa ||
verses.translation: Whatever the Perfect True Guru says, the Transcendent Lord hears.

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਜਗਤ ਮਹਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: soiee varatiaa jagat meh ghaT ghaT mukh bhaniaa ||
verses.translation: It pervades and permeates the whole world, and it is on the mouth of each and every being.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਸਾਹਿਬੈ ਨਹ ਜਾਹੀ ਗਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: bahut vaddiaaieeaa saahibai neh jaahee ganeeaa ||
verses.translation: So numerous are the great glories of the Lord, they cannot even be counted.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਸਿ ਸਚੀ ਗੁਰ ਮਣੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: sach sahaj anadh satiguroo paas sachee gur maneeaa ||
verses.translation: Truth, poise and bliss rest in the True Guru; the Guru bestows the jewel of Truth.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਸਚੇ ਜਿਉ ਬਣਿਆ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: naanak sa(n)t savaare paarabraham sache jiau baniaa ||12||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Supreme Lord God embellishes the Saints, who become like the True Lord. ||12||
Shalok, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਅਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: apanaa aap na pachhaaniee har prabh jaataa dhoor ||
verses.translation: He does not understand himself; he believes the Lord God to be far away.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਵਿਸਰੀ ਕਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee sevaa visaree kiau man rahai hajoor ||
verses.translation: He forgets to serve the Guru; how can his mind remain in the Lord's Presence?

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਝੂਠੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਕੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh janam gavaiaa jhooThai laalach koor ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukh wastes away his life in worthless greed and falsehood.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak bakhas milaian sachai sabadh hadhoor ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord forgives, and blends them with Himself; through the True Word of the Shabad, He is ever-present. ||1||
Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: har prabh sachaa sohilaa gurmukh naam govi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: True is the Praise of the Lord God; the Gurmukh chants the Name of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin naam salaahanaa har japiaa man aana(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Praising the Naam night and day, and meditating on the Lord, the mind becomes blissful.
By great good fortune, I have found the Lord, the perfect embodiment of supreme bliss.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਭੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak naam salaahiaa bahuR na man tan bha(n)g ||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak praises the Naam; his mind and body shall never again be shattered. ||2||
Pauree:

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: koiee ni(n)dhak hovai satiguroo kaa fir saran gur aavai ||
verses.translation: If someone slanders the True Guru, and then comes seeking the Guru's Protection,

verses.original: ਪਿਛਲੇ ਗੁਨਹ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਨਾਲਿ ਰਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: pichhale guneh satigur bakhas le satasa(n)gat naal ralaavai ||
verses.translation: the True Guru forgives him for his past sins, and unites him with the Saints' Congregation.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਮੀਹਿ ਵੁਠੈ ਗਲੀਆ ਨਾਲਿਆ ਟੋਭਿਆ ਕਾ ਜਲੁ ਜਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਮਿਲਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਪਾਵਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau meeh vuThai galeeaa naaliaa Tobhiaa kaa jal jai pavai vich surasaree surasaree milat pavitr paavan hoi jaavai ||
verses.translation: When the rain falls, the water in the streams, rivers and ponds flows into the Ganges; flowing into the Ganges, it is made sacred and pure.

verses.original: ਏਹ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਿਰਵੈਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਤੜ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: eh vaddiaaiee satigur niravair vich jit miliaai tisanaa bhukh utarai har saa(n)t taR aavai ||
verses.translation: Such is the glorious greatness of the True Guru, who has no vengeance; meeting with Him, thirst and hunger are quenched, and instantly, one attains celestial peace.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੋ ਮੰਨੈ ਸੁ ਸਭਨਾਂ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੧੩॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
verses.translit: naanak ih acharaj dhekhahu mere har sache saeh kaa j satiguroo no ma(n)nai su sabhanaa(n) bhaavai ||13||1|| sudh ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, behold this wonder of the Lord, my True King! Everyone is pleased with one who obeys and believes in the True Guru. ||13||1|| Sudh||
Bilaaval, The Word Of The Devotees.
Of Kabeer Jee:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਐਸੋ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਪੇਖਨਾ ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਪਈਹੈ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: aaiso ih sa(n)saar pekhanaa rahan na kouoo pieehai re ||
verses.translation: This world is a drama; no one can remain here.

verses.original: ਸੂਧੇ ਸੂਧੇ ਰੇਗਿ ਚਲਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਨਤਰ ਕੁਧਕਾ ਦਿਵਈਹੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: soodhe soodhe reg chalahu tum natar kudhakaa dhivieehai re ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Walk the straight path; otherwise, you will be pushed around. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਾਰੇ ਬੂਢੇ ਤਰੁਨੇ ਭਈਆ ਸਭਹੂ ਜਮੁ ਲੈ ਜਈਹੈ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: baare boodde tarune bhieeaa sabhahoo jam lai jieehai re ||
verses.translation: The children, the young and the old, O Siblings of Destiny, will be taken away by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਮਾਨਸੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਮੂਸਾ ਕੀਨੋ ਮੀਚੁ ਬਿਲਈਆ ਖਈਹੈ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maanas bapuraa moosaa keeno meech bilieeaa khieehai re ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord has made the poor man a mouse, and the cat of Death is eating him up. ||1||

verses.original: ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ਅਰੁ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਮਨਈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਕਾਨੀ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhanava(n)taa ar niradhan maniee taa kee kachhoo na kaanee re ||
verses.translation: It gives no special consideration to either the rich or the poor.

verses.original: ਰਾਜਾ ਪਰਜਾ ਸਮ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਰੈ ਐਸੋ ਕਾਲੁ ਬਡਾਨੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raajaa parajaa sam kar maarai aaiso kaal baddaanee re ||2||
verses.translation: The king and his subjects are equally killed; such is the power of Death. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਏ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sevak jo har bhaae tin(h) kee kathaa niraaree re ||
verses.translation: Those who are pleasing to the Lord are the servants of the Lord; their story is unique and singular.

verses.original: ਆਵਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਮਰਤੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸੰਗਾਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aaveh na jaeh na kabahoo marate paarabraham sa(n)gaaree re ||3||
verses.translation: They do not come and go, and they never die; they remain with the Supreme Lord God. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਲਛਿਮੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਇਹੈ ਤਜਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨੀ ਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: putr kalatr lachhimee maiaa ihai tajahu jeea jaanee re ||
verses.translation: Know this in your soul, that by renouncing your children, spouse, wealth and property

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਮਿਲਿਹੈ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਨੀ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer sunahu re sa(n)tahu milihai saarigapaanee re ||4||1||
verses.translation: - says Kabeer, listen, O Saints - you shall be united with the Lord of the Universe. ||4||1||
Bilaaval:

verses.original: ਬਿਦਿਆ ਨ ਪਰਉ ਬਾਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
verses.translit: bidhiaa na parau baadh nahee jaanau ||
verses.translation: I do not read books of knowledge, and I do not understand the debates.
I have gone insane, chanting and hearing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਬਾ ਮੈ ਬਉਰਾ ਸਭ ਖਲਕ ਸੈਆਨੀ ਮੈ ਬਉਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: mere baabaa mai bauraa sabh khalak saiaanee mai bauraa ||
verses.translation: O my father, I have gone insane; the whole world is sane, and I am insane.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਬਿਗਰਿਓ ਬਿਗਰੈ ਮਤਿ ਅਉਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mai bigario bigarai mat aauraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am spoiled; let no one else be spoiled like me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਬਉਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੀਓ ਬਉਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aap na bauraa raam keeo bauraa ||
verses.translation: I have not made myself go insane - the Lord made me go insane.
The True Guru has burnt away my doubt. ||2||
I am spoiled; I have lost my intellect.
Let no one go astray in doubt like me. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਬਉਰਾ ਜੋ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: so bauraa jo aap na pachhaanai ||
verses.translation: He alone is insane, who does not understand himself.
When he understands himself, then he knows the One Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਅਬਹਿ ਨ ਮਾਤਾ ਸੁ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: abeh na maataa su kabahu na maataa ||
verses.translation: One who is not intoxicated with the Lord now, shall never be intoxicated.
Says Kabeer, I am imbued with the Lord's Love. ||5||2||
Bilaaval:

verses.original: ਗ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਬਨ ਖੰਡ ਜਾਈਐ ਚੁਨਿ ਖਾਈਐ ਕੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: girahu taj ban kha(n)dd jaieeaai chun khaieeaai ka(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: Abandoning his household, he may go to the forest, and live by eating roots;

verses.original: ਅਜਹੁ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਨ ਛੋਡਈ ਪਾਪੀ ਮਨੁ ਮੰਦਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ajahu bikaar na chhoddiee paapee man ma(n)dhaa ||1||
verses.translation: but even so, his sinful, evil mind does not renounce corruption. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਛੂਟਉ ਕੈਸੇ ਤਰਉ ਭਵਜਲ ਨਿਧਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kiau chhooTau kaise tarau bhavajal nidh bhaaree ||
verses.translation: How can anyone be saved? How can anyone cross over the terrifying world-ocean?

verses.original: ਰਾਖੁ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ਜਨੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raakh raakh mere beeThulaa jan saran tum(h)aaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Save me, save me, O my Lord! Your humble servant seeks Your Sanctuary. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਖੈ ਕੀ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਤਜੀਅ ਨਹ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bikhai bikhai kee baasanaa tajeea neh jaiee ||
verses.translation: I cannot escape my desire for sin and corruption.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੀਐ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਲਪਟਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: anik jatan kar raakheeaai fir fir lapaTaiee ||2||
verses.translation: I make all sorts of efforts to hold back from this desire, but it clings to me, again and again. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਰਾ ਜੀਵਨ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਗਇਆ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਨ ਨੀਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: jaraa jeevan joban giaa kichh keeaa na neekaa ||
verses.translation: Youth and old age - my entire life has passed, but I haven't done any good.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੋ ਕਉਡੀ ਲਗਿ ਮੀਕਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eih jeearaa niramolako kauddee lag meekaa ||3||
verses.translation: This priceless soul has been treated as if if were worth no more than a shell. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਧਵਾ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਬਿਆਪੀ ॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer mere maadhavaa too sarab biaapee ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, O my Lord, You are contained in all.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਪਾਪੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: tum samasar naahee dhiaal moh samasar paapee ||4||3||
verses.translation: There is none as merciful as You are, and none as sinful as I am. ||4||3||
Bilaaval:

verses.original: ਨਿਤ ਉਠਿ ਕੋਰੀ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਆਨੈ ਲੀਪਤ ਜੀਉ ਗਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: nit uTh koree gaagar aanai leepat jeeau gio ||
verses.translation: Every day, he rises early, and brings a fresh clay pot; he passes his life embellishing and glazing it.

verses.original: ਤਾਨਾ ਬਾਨਾ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਲਪਟਿਓ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taanaa baanaa kachhoo na soojhai har har ras lapaTio ||1||
verses.translation: He does not think at all of worldly weaving; he is absorbed in the subtle essence of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
Who in our family has ever chanted the Name of the Lord?

verses.original: ਜਬ ਕੀ ਮਾਲਾ ਲਈ ਨਿਪੂਤੇ ਤਬ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਭਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jab kee maalaa liee nipoote tab te sukh na bhio ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Ever since this worthless son of mine began chanting with his mala, we have had no peace at all! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਿਠਾਨੀ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਦਿਰਾਨੀ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਏਕੁ ਭਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: sunahu jiThaanee sunahu dhiraanee acharaj ek bhio ||
verses.translation: Listen, O my sisters-in-law, a wondrous thing has happened!

verses.original: ਸਾਤ ਸੂਤ ਇਨਿ ਮੁਡੀਂਏ ਖੋਏ ਇਹੁ ਮੁਡੀਆ ਕਿਉ ਨ ਮੁਇਓ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: saat soot in muddee(n)e khoe ih muddeeaa kiau na muio ||2||
verses.translation: This boy has ruined our weaving business. Why didn't he simply die? ||2||

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਏਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: sarab sukhaa kaa ek har suaamee so gur naam dhio ||
verses.translation: O mother, the One Lord, the Lord and Master, is the source of all peace. The Guru has blessed me with His Name.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਹਰਨਾਖਸੁ ਨਖ ਬਿਦਰਿਓ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t prahalaadh kee paij jin raakhee haranaakhas nakh bidhario ||3||
verses.translation: He preserved the honor of Prahlaad, and destroyed Harnaakhash with his nails. ||3||

verses.original: ਘਰ ਕੇ ਦੇਵ ਪਿਤਰ ਕੀ ਛੋਡੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਲਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ke dhev pitar kee chhoddee gur ko sabadh lio ||
verses.translation: I have renounced the gods and ancestors of my house, for the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਨੁ ਸੰਤਹ ਲੈ ਉਧਰਿਓ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahat kabeer sagal paap kha(n)ddan sa(n)teh lai udhario ||4||4||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, God is the Destroyer of all sins; He is the Saving Grace of His Saints. ||4||4||
Bilaaval:
There is no king equal to the Lord.

verses.original: ਏ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਸਭ ਦਿਵਸ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਕਰਤ ਦਿਵਾਜਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: e bhoopat sabh dhivas chaar ke jhooThe karat dhivaajaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: All these lords of the world last for only a few days, putting on their false displays. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੋ ਜਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੋਇ ਕਤ ਡੋਲੈ ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਨ ਪਰ ਛਾਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: tero jan hoi soi kat ddolai teen bhavan par chhaajaa ||
verses.translation: How can Your humble servant waver? You spread Your shadow over the three worlds.

verses.original: ਹਾਥੁ ਪਸਾਰਿ ਸਕੈ ਕੋ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਬੋਲਿ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਅੰਦਾਜਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: haath pasaar sakai ko jan kau bol sakai na a(n)dhaajaa ||1||
verses.translation: Who can raise his hand against Your humble servant? No one can describe the Lord's expanse. ||1||

verses.original: ਚੇਤਿ ਅਚੇਤ ਮੂੜ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਬਾਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: chet achet mooR man mere baaje anahadh baajaa ||
verses.translation: Remember Him, O my thoughtless and foolish mind, and the unstruck melody of the sound current will resonate and resound.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੰਸਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਚੂਕੋ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ॥੨॥੫॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer sa(n)saa bhram chooko dhraoo prahilaadh nivaajaa ||2||5||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, my skepticism and doubt have been dispelled; the Lord has exalted me, as He did Dhroo and Prahlaad. ||2||5||
Bilaaval:
Save me! I have disobeyed You.

verses.original: ਸੀਲੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਜਪੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ਹਉ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ਟੇਢ ਪਗਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: seel dharam jap bhagat na keenee hau abhimaan Tedd pagaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have not practiced humility, righteousness or devotional worship; I am proud and egotistical, and I have taken a crooked path. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਮਰ ਜਾਨਿ ਸੰਚੀ ਇਹ ਕਾਇਆ ਇਹ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਾਚੀ ਗਗਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: amar jaan sa(n)chee ieh kaiaa ieh mithiaa kaachee gagaree ||
verses.translation: Believing this body to be immortal, I pampered it, but it is a fragile and perishable vessel.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਜਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਅਵਰ ਲਗਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jineh nivaaj saaj ham ke'ee tiseh bisaar avar lagaree ||1||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Lord who formed, fashioned and embellished me, I have become attached to another. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਧਿਕ ਤੋਹਿ ਸਾਧ ਨਹੀ ਕਹੀਅਉ ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰੇ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਪਗਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)dhik toh saadh nahee kaheeaau saran pare tumaree pagaree ||
verses.translation: I am Your thief; I cannot be called holy. I have fallen at Your feet, seeking Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਇਹ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਸੁਨੀਅਹੁ ਮਤ ਘਾਲਹੁ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਖਬਰੀ ॥੨॥੬॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer ieh binatee suneeahu mat ghaalahu jam kee khabaree ||2||6||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, please listen to this prayer of mine, O Lord; please do not send me sommons of the Messenger of Death. ||2||6||
Bilaaval:
I stand humbly at Your Court.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਕੋ ਮੇਰੀ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਖੋਲਿੑ ਕਿਵਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tujh bin surat karai ko meree dharasan dheejai kholi(h) kivaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Who else can take care of me, other than You? Please open Your door, and grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਧਨ ਧਨੀ ਉਦਾਰ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਨੑ ਸੁਨੀਅਤੁ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: tum dhan dhanee udhaar tiaagee sravanan(h) suneeat sujas tum(h)aar ||
verses.translation: You are the richest of the rich, generous and unattached. With my ears, I listen to Your Praises.

verses.original: ਮਾਗਉ ਕਾਹਿ ਰੰਕ ਸਭ ਦੇਖਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮੇਰੋ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maagau kaeh ra(n)k sabh dhekhau tum(h) hee te mero nisataar ||1||
verses.translation: From whom should I beg? I see that all are beggars. My salvation comes only from You. ||1||

verses.original: ਜੈਦੇਉ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਿਪ ਸੁਦਾਮਾ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਭਈ ਹੈ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: jaidheau naamaa bip sudhaamaa tin kau kirapaa bhiee hai apaar ||
verses.translation: You blessed Jai Dayv, Naam Dayv and Sudaamaa the Brahmin with Your infinite mercy.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੁਮ ਸੰਮ੍ਰਥ ਦਾਤੇ ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਦੇਤ ਨ ਬਾਰ ॥੨॥੭॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer tum sa(n)mrath dhaate chaar padhaarath dhet na baar ||2||7||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, You are the All-powerful Lord, the Great Giver; in an instant, You bestow the four great blessings. ||2||7||
Bilaaval:
He has a walking stick, ear-rings, a patched coat and a begging bowl.
Wearing the robes of a beggar, he wanders around, deluded by doubt. ||1||
Abandon your Yogic postures and breath control exercises, O madman.

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਬਵਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chhodd kapaT nit har bhaj bavare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Renounce fraud and deception, and meditate continuously on the Lord, O madman. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਤੂ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਸੋ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਨ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeh too jaacheh so tirabhavan bhogee ||
verses.translation: That which you beg for, has been enjoyed in the three worlds.
Says Kabeer, the Lord is the only Yogi in the world. ||2||8||
Bilaaval:

verses.original: ਇਨਿੑ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਤੁਮੑਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਬਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: eini(h) maiaa jagadhees gusaiee tum(h)re charan bisaare ||
verses.translation: This Maya has made me forget Your feet, O Lord of the World, Master of the Universe.

verses.original: ਕਿੰਚਤ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਉਪਜੈ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਨ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੇਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ki(n)chat preet na upajai jan kau jan kahaa kareh bechaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Not even a bit of love wells up in Your humble servant; what can Your poor servant do? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧਨੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਫੰਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhirag tan dhirag dhan dhirag ieh maiaa dhirag dhirag mat budh fa(n)nee ||
verses.translation: Cursed is the body, cursed is the wealth, and cursed is this Maya; cursed, cursed is the clever intellect and understanding.

verses.original: ਇਸ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਆਪ ਬਚੰਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eis maiaa kau dhiraR kar raakhahu baa(n)dhe aap bacha(n)nee ||1||
verses.translation: Restrain and hold back this Maya; overcome it, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਖੇਤੀ ਕਿਆ ਲੇਵਾ ਦੇਈ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਝੂਠੁ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa khetee kiaa levaa dheiee parapa(n)ch jhooTh gumaanaa ||
verses.translation: What good is farming, and what good is trading? Worldly entanglements and pride are false.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਬਿਗੂਤੇ ਆਇਆ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਿਦਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੯॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer te a(n)t bigoote aaiaa kaal nidhaanaa ||2||9||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, in the end, they are ruined; ultimately, Death will come for them. ||2||9||
Bilaaval:

verses.original: ਸਰੀਰ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਭੀਤਰੇ ਆਛੈ ਕਮਲ ਅਨੂਪ ॥
verses.translit: sareer sarovar bheetare aachhai kamal anoop ||
verses.translation: Within the pool of the body, there is an incomparably beautiful lotus flower.

verses.original: ਪਰਮ ਜੋਤਿ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੋ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰੇਖ ਨ ਰੂਪ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: param jot purakhotamo jaa kai rekh na roop ||1||
verses.translation: Within it, is the Supreme Light, the Supreme Soul, who has no feature or form. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: re man har bhaj bhram tajahu jagajeevan raam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O my mind, vibrate, meditate on the Lord, and forsake your doubt. The Lord is the Life of the World. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਵਤ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਦੀਸਈ ਨਹ ਦੀਸੈ ਜਾਤ ॥
verses.translit: aavat kachhoo na dheesiee neh dheesai jaat ||
verses.translation: Nothing is seen coming into the world, and nothing is seen leaving it.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਤਹੀ ਜੈਸੇ ਪੁਰਿਵਨ ਪਾਤ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jeh upajai binasai tahee jaise purivan paat ||2||
verses.translation: Where the body is born, there it dies, like the leaves of the water-lily. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਜੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: mithiaa kar maiaa tajee sukh sahaj beechaar ||
verses.translation: Maya is false and transitory; forsaking it, one obtains peaceful, celestial contemplation.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੰਝਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੩॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer sevaa karahu man ma(n)jh muraar ||3||10||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, serve Him within your mind; He is the Enemy of ego, the Destroyer of demons. ||3||10||
Bilaaval:

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਕਾ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran kaa bhram giaa gobidh liv laagee ||
verses.translation: The illusion of birth and death is gone; I lovingly focus on the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਜੀਵਤ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਜਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeevat su(n)n samaaniaa gur saakhee jaagee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In my life, I am absorbed in deep silent meditation; the Guru's Teachings have awakened me. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਸੀ ਤੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਧੁਨਿ ਕਾਸੀ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaasee te dhun uoopajai dhun kaasee jaiee ||
verses.translation: The sound made from bronze, that sound goes into the bronze again.

verses.original: ਕਾਸੀ ਫੂਟੀ ਪੰਡਿਤਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਕਹਾਂ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaasee fooTee pa(n)dditaa dhun kahaa(n) samaiee ||1||
verses.translation: But when the bronze is broken, O Pandit, O religious scholar, where does the sound go then? ||1||

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਸੰਧਿ ਮੈ ਪੇਖਿਆ ਘਟ ਹੂ ਘਟ ਜਾਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: tirakuTee sa(n)dh mai pekhiaa ghaT hoo ghaT jaagee ||
verses.translation: I gaze upon the world, the confluence of the three qualities; God is awake and aware in each and every heart.

verses.original: ਐਸੀ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਮਾਚਰੀ ਘਟ ਮਾਹਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aaisee budh samaacharee ghaT maeh tiaagee ||2||
verses.translation: Such is the understanding revealed to me; within my heart, I have become a detached renunciate. ||2||

verses.original: ਆਪੁ ਆਪ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਤੇਜ ਤੇਜੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: aap aap te jaaniaa tej tej samaanaa ||
verses.translation: I have come to know my own self, and my light has merged in the Light.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਾ ॥੩॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: kahu kabeer ab jaaniaa gobidh man maanaa ||3||11||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, now I know the Lord of the Universe, and my mind is satisfied. ||3||11||
Bilaaval:

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਹਿ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਕਿਉ ਡੋਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal jaa kai ridhai baseh so jan kiau ddolai dhev ||
verses.translation: When Your Lotus Feet dwell within one's heart, why should that person waver, O Divine Lord?

verses.original: ਮਾਨੌ ਸਭ ਸੁਖ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਜਸੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maanau sabh sukh nau nidh taa kai sahaj sahaj jas bolai dhev || rahaau ||
verses.translation: I know that all comforts, and the nine treasures, come to one who intuitively, naturally, chants the Praise of the Divine Lord. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਬ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਜਉ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਪੇਖੈ ਕੁਟਿਲ ਗਾਂਠਿ ਜਬ ਖੋਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: tab ieh mat jau sabh meh pekhai kuTil gaa(n)Th jab kholai dhev ||
verses.translation: Such wisdom comes, only when one sees the Lord in all, and unties the knot of hypocrisy.

verses.original: ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਅਟਕੈ ਲੈ ਨਰਜਾ ਮਨੁ ਤੋਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: baara(n) baar maiaa te aTakai lai narajaa man tolai dhev ||1||
verses.translation: Time and time again, he must hold himself back from Maya; let him take the scale of the Lord, and weigh his mind. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਉਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਤਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਾਸੁ ਨ ਝੋਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: jeh uh jai tahee sukh paavai maiaa taas na jholai dhev ||
verses.translation: Then wherever he goes, he will find peace, and Maya will not shake him.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਕੀਓ ਲੈ ਦੇਵ ॥੨॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer meraa man maaniaa raam preet keeo lai dhev ||2||12||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, my mind believes in the Lord; I am absorbed in the Love of the Divine Lord. ||2||12||

verses.original: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੀ
verses.translit: bilaaval baanee bhagat naamadhev jee kee
verses.translation: Bilaaval, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: safal janam mo kau gur keenaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru has made my life fruitful.
My pain is forgotten, and I have found peace deep within myself. ||1||

verses.original: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: giaan a(n)jan mo kau gur dheenaa ||
verses.translation: The Guru has blessed me with the ointment of spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਮਨ ਹੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam bin jeevan man heenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, life is mindless. ||1||Pause||
Meditating in remembrance, Naam Dayv has come to know the Lord.
His soul is blended with the Lord, the Life of the World. ||2||1||
Bilaaval, The Word Of Devotee Ravi Daas:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਦਾਰਿਦੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਹਸੈ ਐਸੀ ਦਸਾ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhaaridh dhekh sabh ko hasai aaisee dhasaa hamaaree ||
