verses.translit: kooTan soi ju man kau kooTai ||
verses.translation: He alone is a pimp, who pounds down his mind.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੂਟੈ ਤਉ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: man kooTai tau jam te chhooTai ||
verses.translation: Pounding down his mind, he escapes from the Messenger of Death.
Pounding and beating his mind, he puts it to the test;
such a pimp attains total liberation. ||1||
Who is called a pimp in this world?

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਬੋਲਨ ਕੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਬੀਚਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal bolan ke maeh beechaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In all speech, one must carefully consider. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਚਨੁ ਸੋਇ ਜੁ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਚੈ ॥
verses.translit: naachan soi ju man siau naachai ||
verses.translation: He alone is a dancer, who dances with his mind.
The Lord is not satisfied with falsehood; He is pleased only with Truth.
So play the beat of the drum in the mind.
The Lord is the Protector of the dancer with such a mind. ||2||
She alone is a street-dancer, who cleanses her body-street,
and educates the five passions.
She who embraces devotional worship for the Lord
- I accept such a street-dancer as my Guru. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਸਕਰੁ ਸੋਇ ਜਿ ਤਾਤਿ ਨ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: tasakar soi j taat na karai ||
verses.translation: He alone is a thief, who is above envy,
and who uses his sense organs to chant the Lord's Name.
Says Kabeer, these are the qualities of the one
I know as my Blessed Divine Guru, who is the most beautiful and wise. ||4||7||10||
Gond:
Blessed is the Lord of the World. Blessed is the Divine Guru.
Blessed is that grain, by which the heart-lotus of the hungry blossoms forth.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਓਇ ਸੰਤ ਜਿਨ ਐਸੀ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhan oi sa(n)t jin aaisee jaanee ||
verses.translation: Blessed are those Saints, who know this.
Meeting with them, one meets the Lord, the Sustainer of the World. ||1||
This grain comes from the Primal Lord God.

verses.original: ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਨ ਕੈ ਸਾਦਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: japeeaai naam a(n)n kai saadh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, only when he tastes this grain. ||1||Pause||
Meditate on the Naam, and meditate on this grain.
Mixed with water, its taste becomes sublime.
One who abstains from this grain,
loses his honor in the three worlds. ||2||
One who discards this grain, is practicing hypocrisy.
She is neither a happy soul-bride, nor a widow.
Those who claim in this world that they live on milk alone,
secretly eat whole loads of food. ||3||
Without this grain, time does not pass in peace.
Forsaking this grain, one does not meet the Lord of the World.
Says Kabeer, this I know:
blessed is that grain, which brings faith in the Lord and Master to the mind. ||4||8||11||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: raag go(n)dd baanee naamadheau jee kee ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Gond, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The ritual sacrifice of horses,
giving one's weight in gold to charities,
and ceremonial cleansing baths -||1||

verses.original: ਤਉ ਨ ਪੁਜਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: tau na pujeh har keerat naamaa ||
verses.translation: These are not equal to singing the Praises of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਭਜੁ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਆਲਸੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: apune raameh bhaj re man aalaseeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditate on your Lord, you lazy man! ||1||Pause||
Offering sweet rice at Gaya,
living on the river banks at Benares,
reciting the four Vedas by heart;||2||
Completing all religious rituals,
restraining sexual passion by the spiritual wisdom given by the Guru,
and performing the six rituals;||3||
Expounding on Shiva and Shakti
O man, renounce and abandon all these things.
Meditate, meditate in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe.
Meditate, O Naam Dayv, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||4||1||
Gond:
The deer is lured by the sound of the hunter's bell;

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਜੇ ਵਾ ਕੋ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: praan taje vaa ko dhiaan na jaae ||1||
verses.translation: it loses its life, but it cannot stop thinking about it. ||1||
In the same way, I look upon my Lord.

verses.original: ਰਾਮੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਅਨਤ ਨ ਫੇਰਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam chhodd chit anat na ferau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I will not abandon my Lord, and turn my thoughts to another. ||1||Pause||
As the fisherman looks upon the fish,
and the goldsmith looks upon the gold he fashions;||2||
As the man driven by sex looks upon another man's wife,
and the gambler looks upon the throwing of the dice -||3||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਤਹ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jeh dhekhau teh teh raamaa ||
verses.translation: In the same way, wherever Naam Dayv looks, he sees the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: har ke charan nit dhiaavai naamaa ||4||2||
verses.translation: Naam Dayv meditates continuously on the Feet of the Lord. ||4||2||
Gond:

verses.original: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਤਾਰਿ ਲੇ ਰਾਮਾ ਤਾਰਿ ਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: mo kau taar le raamaa taar le ||
verses.translation: Carry me across, O Lord, carry me across.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਅਜਾਨੁ ਜਨੁ ਤਰਿਬੇ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ਬਾਪ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ਬਾਹ ਦੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mai ajaan jan taribe na jaanau baap beeThulaa baeh dhe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am ignorant, and I do not know how to swim. O my Beloved Father, please give me Your arm. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਰ ਤੇ ਸੁਰ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਤ ਨਿਮਖ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਖਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: nar te sur hoi jaat nimakh mai satigur budh sikhalaiee ||
verses.translation: I have been transformed from a mortal being into an angel, in an instant; the True Guru has taught me this.

verses.original: ਨਰ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿ ਸੁਰਗ ਕਉ ਜੀਤਿਓ ਸੋ ਅਵਖਧ ਮੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nar te upaj surag kau jeetio so avakhadh mai paiee ||1||
verses.translation: Born of human flesh, I have conquered the heavens; such is the medicine I was given. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਹਾ ਜਹਾ ਧੂਅ ਨਾਰਦੁ ਟੇਕੇ ਨੈਕੁ ਟਿਕਾਵਹੁ ਮੋਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jahaa jahaa dhooa naaradh Teke naik Tikaavahu moh ||
verses.translation: Please place me where You placed Dhroo and Naarad, O my Master.

verses.original: ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਵਿਲੰਬਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਨ ਉਧਰੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਕੀ ਨਿਜ ਮਤਿ ਏਹ ॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: tere naam avila(n)b bahut jan udhare naame kee nij mat eh ||2||3||
verses.translation: With the Support of Your Name, so many have been saved; this is Naam Dayv's understanding. ||2||3||
Gond:
I am restless and unhappy.
Without her calf, the cow is lonely. ||1||
Without water, the fish writhes in pain.

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਪੁਰੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaise raam naamaa bin baapuro naamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: So is poor Naam Dayv without the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
Like the cow's calf, which, when let loose,
sucks at her udders and drinks her milk -||2||
So has Naam Dayv found the Lord.
Meeting the Guru, I have seen the Unseen Lord. ||3||
As the man driven by sex wants another man's wife,
so does Naam Dayv love the Lord. ||4||
As the earth burns in the dazzling sunlight,

verses.original: ਤੈਸੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਪੁਰੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੫॥੪॥
verses.translit: taise raam naamaa bin baapuro naamaa ||5||4||
verses.translation: so does poor Naam Dayv burn without the Lord's Name. ||5||4||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: raag go(n)dd baanee naamadheau jeeau kee ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Raag Gond, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: har har karat miTe sabh bharamaa ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, all doubts are dispelled.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਊਤਮ ਧਰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: har ko naam lai uootam dharamaa ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord is the highest religion.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਜਾਤਿ ਕੁਲ ਹਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: har har karat jaat kul haree ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, erases social classes and ancestral pedigrees.
The Lord is the walking stick of the blind. ||1||
I bow to the Lord, I humbly bow to the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਤ ਨਹੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਮਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har karat nahee dhukh jameh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, you will not be tormented by the Messenger of Death. ||1||Pause||
The Lord took the life of Harnaakhash,
and gave Ajaamal a place in heaven.
Teaching a parrot to speak the Lord's Name, Ganika the prostitute was saved.
That Lord is the light of my eyes. ||2||
Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Pootna was saved,
even though she was a deceitful child-killer.
Contemplating the Lord, Dropadi was saved.
Gautam's wife, turned to stone, was saved. ||3||
The Lord, who killed Kaysee and Kans,
gave the gift of life to Kali.
Prays Naam Dayv, such is my Lord;
meditating on Him, fear and suffering are dispelled. ||4||1||5||
Gond:
One who chases after the god Bhairau, evil spirits and the goddess of smallpox,
is riding on a donkey, kicking up the dust. ||1||
I take only the Name of the One Lord.
I have given away all other gods in exchange for Him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਵ ਸਿਵ ਕਰਤੇ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: siv siv karate jo nar dhiaavai ||
verses.translation: That man who chants ""Shiva, Shiva"", and meditates on him,
is riding on a bull, shaking a tambourine. ||2||
One who worships the Great Goddess Maya
will be reincarnated as a woman, and not a man. ||3||
You are called the Primal Goddess.
At the time of liberation, where will you hide then? ||4||
Follow the Guru's Teachings, and hold tight to the Lord's Name, O friend.
Thus prays Naam Dayv, and so says the Gita as well. ||5||2||6||
Bilaaval Gond:

verses.original: ਆਜੁ ਨਾਮੇ ਬੀਠਲੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੋ ਸਮਝਾਊ ਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaj naame beeThal dhekhiaa moorakh ko samajhaauoo re || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Today, Naam Dayv saw the Lord, and so I will instruct the ignorant. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਾਂਡੇ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਾਇਤ੍ਰੀ ਲੋਧੇ ਕਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਖਾਤੀ ਥੀ ॥
verses.translit: paa(n)dde tumaree gaitree lodhe kaa khet khaatee thee ||
verses.translation: O Pandit, O religious scholar, your Gayatri was grazing in the fields.

verses.original: ਲੈ ਕਰਿ ਠੇਗਾ ਟਗਰੀ ਤੋਰੀ ਲਾਂਗਤ ਲਾਂਗਤ ਜਾਤੀ ਥੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: lai kar Thegaa Tagaree toree laa(n)gat laa(n)gat jaatee thee ||1||
verses.translation: Taking a stick, the farmer broke its leg, and now it walks with a limp. ||1||

verses.original: ਪਾਂਡੇ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਧਉਲੇ ਬਲਦ ਚੜਿਆ ਆਵਤੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: paa(n)dde tumaraa mahaadheau dhaule baladh chaRiaa aavat dhekhiaa thaa ||
verses.translation: O Pandit, I saw your great god Shiva, riding along on a white bull.

verses.original: ਮੋਦੀ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਖਾਣਾ ਪਾਕਾ ਵਾ ਕਾ ਲੜਕਾ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਥਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: modhee ke ghar khaanaa paakaa vaa kaa laRakaa maariaa thaa ||2||
verses.translation: In the merchant's house, a banquet was prepared for him - he killed the merchant's son. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਾਂਡੇ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਰਾਮਚੰਦੁ ਸੋ ਭੀ ਆਵਤੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: paa(n)dde tumaraa raamacha(n)dh so bhee aavat dhekhiaa thaa ||
verses.translation: O Pandit, I saw your Raam Chand coming too

verses.original: ਰਾਵਨ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਰਬਰ ਹੋਈ ਘਰ ਕੀ ਜੋਇ ਗਵਾਈ ਥੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: raavan setee sarabar hoiee ghar kee joi gavaiee thee ||3||
verses.translation: ; he lost his wife, fighting a war against Raawan. ||3||
The Hindu is sightless; the Muslim has only one eye.
The spiritual teacher is wiser than both of them.
The Hindu worships at the temple, the Muslim at the mosque.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਸੋਈ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਜਹ ਦੇਹੁਰਾ ਨ ਮਸੀਤਿ ॥੪॥੩॥੭॥
verses.translit: naame soiee seviaa jeh dhehuraa na maseet ||4||3||7||
verses.translation: Naam Dayv serves that Lord, who is not limited to either the temple or the mosque. ||4||3||7||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਗੋਂਡ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: raag go(n)dd baanee ravidhaas jeeau kee ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Raag Gond, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Meditate on the Lord Mukanday, the Liberator, O people of the world.
Without Mukanday, the body shall be reduced to ashes.
Mukanday is the Giver of liberation.
Mukanday is my father and mother. ||1||
Meditate on Mukanday in life, and meditate on Mukanday in death.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: taa ke sevak kau sadhaa ana(n)dhe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: His servant is blissful forever. ||1||Pause||
The Lord, Mukanday, is my breath of life.
Meditating on Mukanday, one's forehead will bear the Lord's insignia of approval.
The renunciate serves Mukanday.
Mukanday is the wealth of the poor and forlorn. ||2||
When the One Liberator does me a favor,
then what can the world do to me?
Erasing my social status, I have entered His Court.
You, Mukanday, are potent throughout the four ages. ||3||
Spiritual wisdom has welled up, and I have been enlightened.
In His Mercy, the Lord has made this worm His slave.
Says Ravi Daas, now my thirst is quenched;
I meditate on Mukanday the Liberator, and I serve Him. ||4||1||
Gond:
Someone may bathe at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage,
and worship the twelve Shiva-lingam stones,
and dig wells and pools,
but if he indulges in slander, then all of this is useless. ||1||
How can the slanderer of the Holy Saints be saved?

verses.original: ਸਰਪਰ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਨਰਕ ਹੀ ਪਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sarapar jaanahu narak hee parai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Know for certain, that he shall go to hell. ||1||Pause||
Someone may bathe at Kuruk-shaytra during a solar eclipse,
and give his decorated wife in offering,
and listen to all the Simritees,
but if he indulges in slander, these are of no account. ||2||
Someone may give countless feasts,
and donate land, and build splendid buildings;
he may neglect his own affairs to work for others,
but if he indulges in slander, he shall wander in countless incarnations. ||3||
Why do you indulge in slander, O people of the world?
The emptiness of the slanderer is soon exposed.
I have thought, and determined the fate of the slanderer.

verses.translit: kahu ravidhaas paapee narak sidhaariaa ||4||2||11||7||2||49|| joR ||
verses.translation: Says Ravi Daas, he is a sinner; he shall go to hell. ||4||2||11||7||2||49|| Total||

verses.translit: raamakalee mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa chaupadhe
verses.translation: Raamkalee, First Mehla, First House, Chau-Padhay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਪੜਤਾ ਸਹਸਾਕਿਰਤਾ ਕੋਈ ਪੜੈ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: koiee paRataa sahasaakirataa koiee paRai puraanaa ||
verses.translation: Some read the Sanskrit scriptures, and some read the Puraanas.

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: koiee naam japai japamaalee laagai tisai dhiaanaa ||
verses.translation: Some meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and chant it on their malas, focusing on it in meditation.

verses.original: ਅਬ ਹੀ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ab hee kab hee kichhoo na jaanaa teraa eko naam pachhaanaa ||1||
verses.translation: I know nothing, now or ever; I recognize only Your One Name, Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਹਰੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਵਨ ਗਤੇ ॥
verses.translit: n jaanaa hare meree kavan gate ||
verses.translation: I do not know, Lord, what my condition shall be.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਲਾਜ ਪਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ham moorakh agiaan saran prabh teree kar kirapaa raakhahu meree laaj pate ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am foolish and ignorant; I seek Your Sanctuary, God. Please, save my honor and my self-respect. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਬਹੂ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਊਭਿ ਚੜਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਇ ਪਇਆਲੇ ॥
verses.translit: kabahoo jeeaRaa uoobh chaRat hai kabahoo jai piaale ||
verses.translation: Sometimes, the soul soars high in the heavens, and sometimes it falls to the depths of the nether regions.

verses.original: ਲੋਭੀ ਜੀਅੜਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਾਲੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: lobhee jeeaRaa thir na rahat hai chaare ku(n)ddaa bhaale ||2||
verses.translation: The greedy soul does not remain stable; it searches in the four directions. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਰਣੁ ਲਿਖਾਇ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਆਏ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸਾਜਹਿ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: maran likhai ma(n)ddal meh aae jeevan saajeh maiee ||
verses.translation: With death pre-ordained, the soul comes into the world, gathering the riches of life.

verses.original: ਏਕਿ ਚਲੇ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਾਹਿ ਬਲੰਤੀ ਆਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ek chale ham dhekheh suaamee bhaeh bala(n)tee aaiee ||3||
verses.translation: I see that some have already gone, O my Lord and Master; the burning fire is coming closer! ||3||

verses.original: ਨ ਕਿਸੀ ਕਾ ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਕਿਸੀ ਕਾ ਭਾਈ ਨਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਬਾਪੁ ਨ ਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: n kisee kaa meet na kisee kaa bhaiee naa kisai baap na maiee ||
verses.translation: No one has any friend, and no one has any brother; no one has any father or mother.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੇ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਅੰਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak je too dheveh a(n)te hoi sakhaiee ||4||1||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, if You bless me with Your Name, it shall be my help and support in the end. ||4||1||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:
Your Light is prevailing everywhere.
Wherever I look, there I see the Lord. ||1||
Please rid me of the desire to live, O my Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਗਾਡਿਆ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਉਤਰਉ ਪਾਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)dh koop maiaa man gaaddiaa kiau kar utarau paar suaamee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My mind is entangled in the deep dark pit of Maya. How can I cross over, O Lord and Master? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਹ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਸਿਆ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: jeh bheetar ghaT bheetar basiaa baahar kaahe naahee ||
verses.translation: He dwells deep within, inside the heart; how can He not be outside as well?

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਿੰਤ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tin kee saar kare nit saahib sadhaa chi(n)t man maahee ||2||
verses.translation: Our Lord and Master always takes care of us, and keeps us in His thoughts. ||2||
He Himself is near at hand, and He is far away.
He Himself is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.
Meeting the True Guru, the darkness is dispelled.
Wherever I look, there I see Him pervading. ||3||

verses.original: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਸਾ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਨੈਣੀ ਲਾਗਸਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)tar sahasaa baahar maiaa nainee laagas baanee ||
verses.translation: There is doubt within me, and Maya is outside; it hits me in the eyes like an arrow.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਪਰਤਾਪਹਿਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak dhaasan dhaasaa parataapahigaa praanee ||4||2||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, the slave of the Lord's slaves: such a mortal suffers terribly. ||4||2||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਦਰਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਕਵਨੁ ਦਰੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਦਰਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਦਰੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਲਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: jit dhar vaseh kavan dhar kaheeaai dharaa bheetar dhar kavan lahai ||
verses.translation: Where is that door, where You live, O Lord? What is that door called? Among all doors, who can find that door?

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਦਰ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਫਿਰਾ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਸੋ ਦਰੁ ਕੋਈ ਆਇ ਕਹੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis dhar kaaran firaa udhaasee so dhar koiee aai kahai ||1||
verses.translation: For the sake of that door, I wander around sadly, detached from the world; if only someone would come and tell me about that door. ||1||
How can I cross over the world-ocean?
While I am living, I cannot be dead. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ਰੋਹੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਦੁਇ ਪਟ ਜੜੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh dharavaajaa roh rakhavaalaa aasaa a(n)dhesaa dhui paT jaRe ||
verses.translation: Pain is the door, and anger is the guard; hope and anxiety are the two shutters.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਜਲੁ ਖਾਈ ਪਾਣੀ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਧਿਆ ਸਤ ਕੈ ਆਸਣਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਰਹੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maiaa jal khaiee paanee ghar baadhiaa sat kai aasan purakh rahai ||2||
verses.translation: Maya is the water in the moat; in the middle of this moat, he has built his home. The Primal Lord sits in the Seat of Truth. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿੰਤੇ ਨਾਮਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਹਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: ki(n)te naamaa a(n)t na jaaniaa tum sar naahee avar hare ||
verses.translation: You have so many Names, Lord, I do not know their limit. There is no other equal to You.

verses.original: ਊਚਾ ਨਹੀ ਕਹਣਾ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਣਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: uoochaa nahee kahanaa man meh rahanaa aape jaanai aap kare ||3||
verses.translation: Do not speak out loud - remain in your mind. The Lord Himself knows, and He Himself acts. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਕਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: jab aasaa a(n)dhesaa tab hee kiau kar ek kahai ||
verses.translation: As long as there is hope, there is anxiety; so how can anyone speak of the One Lord?

verses.original: ਆਸਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਏਕੁ ਮਿਲੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: aasaa bheetar rahai niraasaa tau naanak ek milai ||4||
verses.translation: In the midst of hope, remain untouched by hope; then, O Nanak, you shall meet the One Lord. ||4||
In this way, you shall cross over the world-ocean.
This is the way to remain dead while yet alive. ||1||Second Pause||3||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਾਖੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਬਾਜੈ ਲੋਕੁ ਸੁਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: surat sabadh saakhee meree si(n)n(g)ee baajai lok sune ||
verses.translation: Awareness of the Shabad and the Teachings is my horn; the people hear the sound of its vibrations.

verses.original: ਪਤੁ ਝੋਲੀ ਮੰਗਣ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: pat jholee ma(n)gan kai taiee bheekhiaa naam paRe ||1||
verses.translation: Honor is my begging-bowl, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the charity I receive. ||1||
O Baba, Gorakh is the Lord of the Universe; He is always awake and aware.

verses.original: ਗੋਰਖੁ ਸੋ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੋਇ ਉਠਾਲੀ ਕਰਤੇ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gorakh so jin goi uThaalee karate baar na laagai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He alone is Gorakh, who sustains the earth; He created it in an instant. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਾਣੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਪਵਣਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: paanee praan pavan ba(n)dh raakhe cha(n)dh sooraj mukh dhe'ee ||
verses.translation: Binding together water and air, He infused the breath of life into the body, and made the lamps of the sun and the moon.

verses.original: ਮਰਣ ਜੀਵਣ ਕਉ ਧਰਤੀ ਦੀਨੀ ਏਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਸਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: maran jeevan kau dharatee dheenee ete gun visare ||2||
verses.translation: To die and to live, He gave us the earth, but we have forgotten these blessings. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਅਰੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਜੰਗਮ ਪੀਰ ਪੁਰਸ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: sidh saadhik ar jogee ja(n)gam peer puras bahutere ||
verses.translation: There are so many Siddhas, seekers, Yogis, wandering pilgrims, spiritual teachers and good people.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਾ ਤ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਆਖਾ ਤਾ ਮਨੁ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: je tin milaa ta keerat aakhaa taa man sev kare ||3||
verses.translation: If I meet them, I chant the Lord's Praises, and then, my mind serves Him. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਗਦੁ ਲੂਣੁ ਰਹੈ ਘ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਗੇ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਮਲੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: kaagadh loon rahai ghirat sa(n)ge paanee kamal rahai ||
verses.translation: Paper and salt, protected by ghee, remain untouched by water, as the lotus remains unaffected in water.

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: aaise bhagat mileh jan naanak tin jam kiaa karai ||4||4||
verses.translation: Those who meet with such devotees, O servant Nanak - what can death do to them? ||4||4||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:
Listen, Machhindra, to what Nanak says.
One who subdues the five passions does not waver.
One who practices Yoga in such a way,
saves himself, and saves all his generations. ||1||
He alone is a hermit, who attains such understanding.
Day and night, he remains absorbed in deepest Samaadhi. ||1||Pause||
He begs for loving devotion to the Lord, and lives in the Fear of God.
He is satisfied, with the priceless gift of contentment.
Becoming the embodiment of meditation, he attains the true Yogic posture.
He focuses his consciousness in the deep trance of the True Name. ||2||
Nanak chants the Ambrosial Bani.
Listen, O Machhindra: this is the insignia of the true hermit.
One who, in the midst of hope, remains untouched by hope,
shall truly find the Creator Lord. ||3||
Prays Nanak, I share the mysterious secrets of God.
The Guru and His disciple are joined together!
One who eats this food, this medicine of the Teachings,
has the wisdom of the six Shaastras. ||4||5||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਮ ਡੋਲਤ ਬੇੜੀ ਪਾਪ ਭਰੀ ਹੈ ਪਵਣੁ ਲਗੈ ਮਤੁ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ham ddolat beRee paap bharee hai pavan lagai mat jaiee ||
verses.translation: My boat is wobbly and unsteady; it is filled with sins. The wind is rising - what if it tips over?

verses.original: ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਿਧ ਭੇਟਣ ਕਉ ਆਏ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sanamukh sidh bheTan kau aae nihachau dheh vaddiaaiee ||1||
verses.translation: As sunmukh, I have turned to the Guru; O my Perfect Master; please be sure to bless me with Your glorious greatness. ||1||
O Guru, my Saving Grace, please carry me across the world-ocean.

verses.original: ਦੇਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਵਿਨਾਸੀ ਹਉ ਤੁਝ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dheh bhagat pooran avinaasee hau tujh kau balihaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Bless me with devotion to the perfect, imperishable Lord God; I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਜੋਗੀ ਅਰੁ ਜੰਗਮ ਏਕੁ ਸਿਧੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: sidh saadhik jogee ar ja(n)gam ek sidh jinee dhiaaiaa ||
verses.translation: He alone is a Siddha, a seeker, a Yogi, a wandering pilgrim, who meditates on the One Perfect Lord.

verses.original: ਪਰਸਤ ਪੈਰ ਸਿਝਤ ਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਖਰੁ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: parasat pair sijhat te suaamee akhar jin kau aaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Touching the feet of the Lord Master, they are emancipated; they come to receive the Word of the Teachings. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jap tap sa(n)jam karam na jaanaa naam japee prabh teraa ||
verses.translation: I know nothing of charity, meditation, self-discipline or religious rituals; I only chant Your Name, God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥੩॥੬॥
verses.translit: gur paramesar naanak bheTio saachai sabadh niberaa ||3||6||
verses.translation: Nanak has met the Guru, the Transcendent Lord God; through the True Word of His Shabad, he is set free. ||3||6||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:
Focus your consciousness in deep absorption on the Lord.
Make your body a raft, to cross over.
Deep within is the fire of desire; keep it in check.
Day and night, that lamp shall burn unceasingly. ||1||
Float such a lamp upon the water;

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਦੀਵੈ ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jit dheevai sabh sojhee pai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: this lamp will bring total understanding. ||1||Pause||
This understanding is good clay;
a lamp made of such clay is acceptable to the Lord.
So shape this lamp on the wheel of good actions.
In this world and in the next, this lamp shall be with you. ||2||
When He Himself grants His Grace,
then, as Gurmukh, one may understand Him.
Within the heart, this lamp is permanently lit.
It is not extinguished by water or wind.
Such a lamp will carry you across the water. ||3||
Wind does not shake it, or put it out.
Its light reveals the Divine Throne.
The Kh'shaatriyas, Brahmins, Soodras and Vaishyas
cannot find its value, even by thousands of calculations.
If any of them lights such a lamp,
O Nanak, he is emancipated. ||4||7||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:
To place one's faith in Your Name, Lord, is true worship.
With an offering of Truth, one obtains a place to sit.
If a prayer is offered with truth and contentment,
the Lord will hear it, and call him in to sit by Him. ||1||
O Nanak, no one returns empty-handed;
such is the Court of the True Lord. ||1||Pause||
The treasure I seek is the gift of Your Grace.
Please bless this humble beggar - this is what I seek.
Please, pour Your Love into the cup of my heart.
This is Your pre-determined value. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jin kichh keeaa so kichh karai ||
verses.translation: The One who created everything, does everything.
He Himself appraises His own value.
The Sovereign Lord King becomes manifest to the Gurmukh.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naa ko aavai naa ko jai ||3||
verses.translation: He does not come, and He does not go. ||3||

verses.original: ਲੋਕੁ ਧਿਕਾਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਮਾਗਤ ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: lok dhikaar kahai ma(n)gat jan maagat maan na paiaa ||
verses.translation: People curse at the beggar; by begging, he does not receive honor.

verses.original: ਸਹ ਕੀਆ ਗਲਾ ਦਰ ਕੀਆ ਬਾਤਾ ਤੈ ਤਾ ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: seh keeaa galaa dhar keeaa baataa tai taa kahan kahaiaa ||4||8||
verses.translation: O Lord, You inspire me to speak Your Words, and tell the Story of Your Court. ||4||8||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਬੂੰਦ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਕਵਣੁ ਬੁਝੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: saagar meh boo(n)dh boo(n)dh meh saagar kavan bujhai bidh jaanai ||
verses.translation: The drop is in the ocean, and the ocean is in the drop. Who understands, and knows this?

verses.original: ਉਤਭੁਜ ਚਲਤ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਿ ਚੀਨੈ ਆਪੇ ਤਤੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: autabhuj chalat aap kar cheenai aape tat pachhaanai ||1||
verses.translation: He Himself creates the wondrous play of the world. He Himself contemplates it, and understands its true essence. ||1||
How rare are those who contemplate this spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tis te mukat param gat hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through this, the supreme state of liberation is attained. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਦਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਰੈਣਿ ਮਹਿ ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਉਸਨ ਸੀਤ ਬਿਧਿ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: dhin meh rain rain meh dhineear usan seet bidh soiee ||
verses.translation: The night is in the day, and the day is in the night. The same is true of hot and cold.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taa kee gat mit avar na jaanai gur bin samajh na hoiee ||2||
verses.translation: No one else knows His state and extent; without the Guru, this is not understood. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੁਰਖ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਮਹਿ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: purakh meh naar naar meh purakhaa boojhahu braham giaanee ||
verses.translation: The female is in the male, and the male is in the female. Understand this, O God-realized being!

verses.original: ਧੁਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਿਆਨ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਕਥ ਕਹਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhun meh dhiaan dhiaan meh jaaniaa gurmukh akath kahaanee ||3||
verses.translation: The meditation is in the music, and knowledge is in meditation. Become Gurmukh, and speak the Unspoken Speech. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਪੰਚ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: man meh jot jot meh manooaa pa(n)ch mile gur bhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Light is in the mind, and the mind is in the Light. The Guru brings the five senses together, like brothers.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਿਨ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੪॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak tin kai sadh balihaaree jin ek sabadh liv laiee ||4||9||
verses.translation: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who enshrine love for the One Word of the Shabad. ||4||9||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:
When the Lord God showered His Mercy,
egotism was eradicated from within me.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕਿ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so sevak raam piaaree || jo gur sabadhee beechaaree ||1||
verses.translation: That humble servant who contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad, is very dear to the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: so har jan har prabh bhaavai ||
verses.translation: That humble servant of the Lord is pleasing to his Lord God;

verses.original: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਲਾਜ ਛੋਡਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ahinis bhagat kare dhin raatee laaj chhodd har ke gun gaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: day and night, he performs devotional worship, day and night. Disregarding his own honor, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
The unstruck melody of the sound current resonates and resounds;
my mind is appeased by the subtle essence of the Lord.
Through the Perfect Guru, I am absorbed in Truth.
Through the Guru, I have found the Lord, the Primal Being. ||2||
Gurbani is the sound current of the Naad, the Vedas, everything.
My mind is attuned to the Lord of the Universe.
He is my sacred shrine of pilgrimage, fasting and austere self-discipline.
The Lord saves, and carries across, those who meet with the Guru. ||3||
One whose self-conceit is gone, sees his fears run away.
That servant grasps the Guru's feet.
The Guru, the True Guru, has expelled my doubts.
Says Nanak, I have merged into the Word of the Shabad. ||4||10||
Raamkalee, First Mehla:
He runs around, begging for clothes and food.
He burns with hunger and corruption, and will suffer in the world hereafter.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਲੀਨੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: gurmat nahee leenee dhuramat pat khoiee ||
verses.translation: He does not follow the Guru's Teachings; through his evil-mindedness, he loses his honor.
Only through the Guru's Teachings will such a person become devoted. ||1||
The way of the Yogi is to dwell in the celestial home of bliss.

verses.original: ਏਕ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਏਕੋ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਭਾਇ ਸਬਦਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ek dhirasaT eko kar dhekhiaa bheekhiaa bhai sabadh tirapataasai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He looks impartially, equally upon all. He receives the charity of the Lord's Love, and the Word of the Shabad, and so he is satisfied. ||1||Pause||
The five bulls, the senses, pull the wagon of the body around.
By the Lord's power, one's honor is preserved.
But when the axle breaks, the wagon falls and crashes.
It falls apart, like a pile of logs. ||2||
Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad, Yogi.

verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਮ ਕਰਣਾ ਸੋਗ ਬਿਓਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh sam karanaa sog biogee ||
verses.translation: Look upon pain and pleasure as one and the same, sorrow and separation.
Let your food be contemplative meditation upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Your wall shall be permanent, by meditating on the Formless Lord. ||3||
Wear the loin-cloth of poise, and be free of entanglements.
The Guru's Word shall release you from sexual desire and anger.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: man meh mu(n)dhraa har gur saranaa ||
verses.translation: In your mind, let your ear-rings be the Sanctuary of the Guru, the Lord.
O Nanak, worshipping the Lord in deep devotion, the humble are carried across. ||4||11||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Raamkalee, Third Mehla, First House:
In the Golden Age of Sat Yuga, everyone spoke the Truth.
In each and every home, devotional worship was performed by the people, according to the Guru's Teachings.
In that Golden Age, Dharma had four feet.
How rare are those people who, as Gurmukh, contemplate this and understand. ||1||
In all four ages, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is glory and greatness.

verses.original: ਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: j naam laagai so mukat hovai gur bin naam na paavai koiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: One who holds tight to the Naam is liberated; without the Guru, no one obtains the Naam. ||1||Pause||
In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, one leg was removed.
Hypocrisy became prevalent, and people thought that the Lord was far away.
The Gurmukhs still understood and realized;
the Naam abided deep within them, and they were at peace. ||2||
In the Brass Age of Dwaapur Yuga, duality and double-mindedness arose.
Deluded by doubt, they knew duality.
In this Brass Age, Dharma was left with only two feet.
Those who became Gurmukh implanted the Naam deep within. ||3||
In the Iron Age of Kali Yuga, Dharma was left with only one power.

verses.original: ਇਕ ਪੈਰਿ ਚਲੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: eik pair chalai maiaa moh vadhaae ||
verses.translation: It walks on just one foot; love and emotional attachment to Maya have increased.
Love and emotional attachment to Maya bring total darkness.
If someone meets the True Guru, he is saved, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jug meh saachaa eko soiee ||
verses.translation: Throughout the ages, there is only the One True Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸਚੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh sach dhoojaa nahee koiee ||
verses.translation: Among all, is the True Lord; there is no other at all.
Praising the True Lord, true peace is attained.
How rare are those, who as Gurmukh, chant the Naam. ||5||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਤਮੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: sabh jug meh naam uootam hoiee ||
verses.translation: Throughout all the ages, the Naam is the ultimate, the most sublime.
How rare are those, who as Gurmukh, understand this.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਭਗਤੁ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: har naam dhiaae bhagat jan soiee ||
verses.translation: One who meditates on the Lord's Name is a humble devotee.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੋਈ ॥੬॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak jug jug naam vaddiaaiee hoiee ||6||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, in each and every age, the Naam is glory and greatness. ||6||1||
Raamkalee, Fourth Mehla, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: je vadd bhaag hoveh vaddabhaagee taa har har naam dhiaavai ||
verses.translation: If someone is very fortunate, and is blessed with great high destiny, then he meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naam japat naame sukh paavai har naame naam samaavai ||1||
verses.translation: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he finds peace, and merges in the Naam. ||1||
O mortal, as Gurmukh, worship the Lord in devotion forever.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai pragaas hovai liv laagai gurmat har har naam samaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your heart shall be illumined; through the Guru's Teachings, lovingly attune yourself to the Lord. You shall merge in the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹੀਰਾ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਮਾਣਕ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਰਪੂਰੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: heeraa ratan javehar maanak bahu saagar bharapoor keeaa ||
verses.translation: The Great Giver is filled with diamonds, emeralds, rubies and pearls;

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਵਡ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਵਡ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਤਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਢਿ ਕਢਿ ਲੀਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis vadd bhaag hovai vadd masatak tin gurmat kadd kadd leeaa ||2||
verses.translation: one who has good fortune and great destiny inscribed upon his forehead, digs them out, by following the Guru's Teachings. ||2||

verses.original: ਰਤਨੁ ਜਵੇਹਰੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਤਲੀ ਦਿਖਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: ratan javehar laal har naamaa gur kaadd talee dhikhalaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is the jewel, the emerald, the ruby; digging it out, the Guru has placed it in your palm.

verses.original: ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨਹੀ ਲੀਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਓਲੈ ਲਾਖੁ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhaagaheen manmukh nahee leeaa tiran olai laakh chhapaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: The unfortunate, self-willed manmukh does not obtain it; this priceless jewel remains hidden behind a curtain of straw. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: masatak bhaag hovai dhur likhiaa taa satagur sevaa laae ||
verses.translation: If such pre-ordained destiny is written upon one's forehead, then the True Guru enjoins him to serve Him.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਤਨ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਪਾਵੈ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak ratan javehar paavai dhan dhan gurmat har paae ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, then he obtains the jewel, the gem; blessed, blessed is that one who follows the Guru's Teachings, and finds the Lord. ||4||1||
Raamkalee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਜਨਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਭਇਆ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: raam janaa mil bhiaa ana(n)dhaa har neekee kathaa sunai ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the humble servants of the Lord, I am in ecstasy; they preach the sublime sermon of the Lord.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਨੀਕਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhuramat mail giee sabh neekal satasa(n)gat mil budh pai ||1||
verses.translation: The filth of evil-mindedness is totally washed away; joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, one is blessed with understanding. ||1||
O humble servant of the Lord, follow the Guru's Teachings, and chant the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਕਹੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਜਪਤ ਸੋਹਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo sunai kahai so mukataa raam japat sohai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whoever hears and speaks it is liberated; chanting the Lord's Name, one is embellished with beauty. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਜਨਾ ਭੇਟਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: je vadd bhaag hoveh mukh masatak har raam janaa bheTai ||
verses.translation: If someone has supremely high destiny written on his forehead, the Lord leads him to meet the humble servants of the Lord.

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਸੰਤ ਦੇਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਭੁ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dharasan sa(n)t dheh kar kirapaa sabh dhaaladh dhukh leh jai ||2||
verses.translation: Be merciful, and grant me the Blessed Vision of the Saints' Darshan, which shall rid me of all poverty and pain. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਰਾਮ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਭਾਗਹੀਣ ਨ ਸੁਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har ke log raam jan neeke bhaagaheen na sukhai ||
verses.translation: The Lord's people are good and sublime; the unfortunate ones do not like them at all.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਹਿ ਜਨ ਊਚੇ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਡੰਸੁ ਲਗਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jiau jiau raam kaheh jan uooche nar ni(n)dhak dda(n)s lagai ||3||
verses.translation: The more the Lord's exalted servants speak of Him, the more the slanderers attack and sting them. ||3||

verses.original: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਨਰ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਜਿਨ ਜਨ ਨਹੀ ਭਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸਖਾ ਸਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhirag dhirag nar ni(n)dhak jin jan nahee bhaae har ke sakhaa sakhai ||
verses.translation: Cursed, cursed are the slanderers who do not like the humble, the friends and companions of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚੋਰ ਵੇਮੁਖ ਮੁਖ ਕਾਲੇ ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਨ ਭਾਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: se har ke chor vemukh mukh kaale jin gur kee paij na bhai ||4||
verses.translation: Those who do not like the honor and glory of the Guru are faithless, black-faced thieves, who have turned their backs on the Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਦਇਆ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਮ ਦੀਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhiaa dhiaa kar raakhahu har jeeau ham dheen teree saranai ||
verses.translation: Have mercy, have mercy, please save me, Dear Lord. I am meek and humble - I seek Your protection.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮ ਪਿਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੫॥੨॥
verses.translit: ham baarik tum pitaa prabh mere jan naanak bakhas milai ||5||2||
verses.translation: I am Your child, and You are my father, God. Please forgive servant Nanak and merge him with Yourself. ||5||2||
Raamkalee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸਖਾ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਨੀਕੇ ਤਿਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਵਤਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har ke sakhaa saadh jan neeke tin uoopar haath vataavai ||
verses.translation: The friends of the Lord, the humble, Holy Saints are sublime; the Lord spreads out His protecting hands above them.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੇਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਏ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gurmukh saadh seiee prabh bhaae kar kirapaa aap milaavai ||1||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are the Holy Saints, pleasing to God; in His mercy, He blends them with Himself. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: raam mo kau har jan mel man bhaavai ||
verses.translation: O Lord, my mind longs to meet with the humble servants of the Lord.

verses.original: ਅਮਿਉ ਅਮਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: amiau amiau har ras hai meeThaa mil sa(n)t janaa mukh paavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The sweet, subtle essence of the Lord is immortalizing ambrosia. Meeting the Saints, I drink it in. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਰਾਮ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਮਿਲਿ ਊਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: har ke log raam jan uootam mil uootam padhavee paavai ||
verses.translation: The Lord's people are the most lofty and exalted. Meeting with them, the most exalted status is obtained.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਹੋਵਤ ਚੇਰੀ ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਰਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ham hovat cheree dhaas dhaasan kee meraa Thaakur khusee karaavai ||2||
verses.translation: I am the slave of the slave of the Lord's slaves; my Lord and Master is pleased with me. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਰਿਦ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sevak jan seveh se vaddabhaagee ridh man tan preet lagaavai ||
verses.translation: The humble servant serves; one who enshrines love for the Lord in his heart, mind and body is very fortunate.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਤਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਕੂੜੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bin preetee kareh bahu baataa kooR bol kooRo fal paavai ||3||
verses.translation: One who talks too much without love, speaks falsely, and obtains only false rewards. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਪਗੀ ਲੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: mo kau dhaar kirapaa jagajeevan dhaate har sa(n)t pagee le paavai ||
verses.translation: Take pity on me, O Lord of the World, O Great Giver; let me fall at the feet of the Saints.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਕਾਟਉ ਕਾਟਿ ਬਾਢਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਉ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤੁ ਚੜਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: hau kaaTau kaaT baadd sir raakhau jit naanak sa(n)t chaR aavai ||4||3||
verses.translation: I would cut off my head, and cut it into pieces, O Nanak, and set it down for the Saints to walk upon. ||4||3||
Raamkalee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਵਡ ਮੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਮਿਲਦਿਆ ਢਿਲ ਨ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: je vadd bhaag hoveh vadd mere jan miladhiaa ddil na laieeaai ||
verses.translation: If I am blessed with supreme high destiny, I will meet the humble servants of the Lord, without delay.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੁੰਟ ਸਰ ਨੀਕੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਨਾਵਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har jan a(n)mirat ku(n)T sar neeke vaddabhaagee tit naavaieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servants are pools of ambrosial nectar; by great good fortune, one bathes in them. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: raam mo kau har jan kaarai laieeaai ||
verses.translation: O Lord, let me work for the humble servants of the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਖਾ ਪੀਸਉ ਸੰਤ ਆਗੈ ਪਗ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau paanee pakhaa peesau sa(n)t aagai pag mal mal dhoor mukh laieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I carry water, wave the fan and grind the corn for them; I massage and wash their feet. I apply the dust of their feet to my forehead. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ਜੋ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: har jan vadde vadde vadd uooche jo satagur mel milaieeaai ||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servants are great, very great, the greatest and most exalted; they lead us to meet the True Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satagur jevadd avar na koiee mil satagur purakh dhiaaieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: No one else is as great as the True Guru; meeting the True Guru, I meditate on the Lord, the Primal Being. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: satagur saran pare tin paiaa mere Thaakur laaj rakhaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Those who seek the Sanctuary of the True Guru find the Lord. My Lord and Master saves their honor.

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਅਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ਆਇ ਬਹਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਗੁਲ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: eik apanai suaai aai baheh gur aagai jiau bagul samaadh lagaieeaai ||3||
verses.translation: Some come for their own purposes, and sit before the Guru; they pretend to be in Samaadhi, like storks with their eyes closed. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਗੁਲਾ ਕਾਗ ਨੀਚ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਕਰੰਗ ਬਿਖੂ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: bagulaa kaag neech kee sa(n)gat jai kara(n)g bikhoo mukh laieeaai ||
verses.translation: Associating with the wretched and the lowly, like the stork and the crow, is like feeding on a carcass of poison.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੰਸੁ ਕਰਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: naanak mel mel prabh sa(n)gat mil sa(n)gat ha(n)s karaieeaai ||4||4||
verses.translation: Nanak: O God, unite me with the Sangat, the Congregation. United with the Sangat, I will become a swan. ||4||4||
Raamkalee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: satagur dhiaa karahu har melahu mere preetam praan har raiaa ||
verses.translation: O True Guru, please have compassion, and unite me with the Lord. My Sovereign Lord is the Beloved of my breath of life.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਚੇਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਲਗਹ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ham cheree hoi lageh gur charanee jin har prabh maarag pa(n)th dhikhaiaa ||1||
verses.translation: I am a slave; I fall at the Guru's feet. He has shown me the Path, the Way to my Lord God. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: raam mai har har naam man bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Name of my Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬੇਲੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਖਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mai har bin avar na koiee belee meraa pitaa maataa har sakhaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have no friend except the Lord; the Lord is my father, my mother, my companion. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਨ ਰਹਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ਮਰਹਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mere ik khin praan na raheh bin preetam bin dhekhe mareh meree maiaa ||
verses.translation: My breath of life will not survive for an instant, without my Beloved; unless I see Him, I will die, O my mother!

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan vadd bhaag gur saranee aae har gur mil dharasan paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is my great, high destiny, that I have come to the Guru's Sanctuary. Meeting with the Guru, I have obtained the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸੂਝੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਉ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mai avar na koiee soojhai boojhai man har jap japau japaiaa ||
verses.translation: I do not know or understand any other within my mind; I meditate and chant the Lord's Chant.

verses.original: ਨਾਮਹੀਣ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਨਕਟੇ ਤਿਨ ਘਸਿ ਘਸਿ ਨਕ ਵਢਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naamaheen fireh se nakaTe tin ghas ghas nak vaddaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Those who lack the Naam, wander in shame; their noses are chopped off, bit by bit. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਜੀਵਾਲਿ ਲੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mo kau jagajeevan jeevaal lai suaamee ridh a(n)tar naam vasaiaa ||
verses.translation: O Life of the World, rejuvenate me! O my Lord and Master, enshrine Your Name deep within my heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: naanak guroo guroo hai pooraa mil satigur naam dhiaaiaa ||4||5||
verses.translation: O Nanak, perfect is the Guru, the Guru. Meeting the True Guru, I meditate on the Naam. ||4||5||
Raamkalee, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਵਡਾ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਹਰਿ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: satagur dhaataa vaddaa vadd purakh hai jit miliaai har ur dhaare ||
verses.translation: The True Guru, the Great Giver, is the Great, Primal Being; meeting Him, the Lord is enshrined within the heart.

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jeea dhaan gur poorai dheeaa har a(n)mirat naam samaare ||1||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has granted me the life of the soul; I meditate in remembrance on the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: raam gur har har naam ka(n)Th dhaare ||
verses.translation: O Lord, the Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within my heart.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh kathaa sunee man bhaiee dhan dhan vadd bhaag hamaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, I have heard His sermon, which pleases my mind; blessed, blessed is my great destiny. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: koT koT tetees dhiaaveh taa kaa a(n)t na paaveh paare ||
verses.translation: Millions, three hundred thirty millions of gods meditate on Him, but they cannot find His end or limitation.

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਕਾਮ ਕਾਮਨੀ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਰਿਧਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਹਾਥੁ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: hiradhai kaam kaamanee maageh ridh maageh haath pasaare ||2||
verses.translation: With sexual urges in their hearts, they beg for beautiful women; stretching out their hands, they beg for riches. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਜਪਿ ਜਪੁ ਵਡਾ ਵਡੇਰਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਖਉ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har jas jap jap vaddaa vadderaa gurmukh rakhau ur dhaare ||
verses.translation: One who chants the Praises of the Lord is the greatest of the great; the Gurmukh keeps the Lord clasped to his heart.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਵਡ ਭਾਗ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: je vadd bhaag hoveh taa japeeaai har bhaujal paar utaare ||3||
verses.translation: If one is blessed with high destiny, he meditates on the Lord, who carries him across the terrifying world-ocean. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਕੰਠਿ ਜਨ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har jan nikaT nikaT har jan hai har raakhai ka(n)Th jan dhaare ||
verses.translation: The Lord is close to His humble servant, and His humble servant is close to the Lord; He keeps His humble servant clasped to His Heart.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਤਾ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: naanak pitaa maataa hai har prabh ham baarik har pratipaare ||4||6||18||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Lord God is our father and mother. I am His child; the Lord cherishes me. ||4||6||18||

verses.translit: raag raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਦੀਨ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗਣੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: kirapaa karahu dheen ke dhaate meraa gun avagan na beechaarahu koiee ||
verses.translation: Have mercy on me, O Generous Giver, Lord of the meek; please do not consider my merits and demerits.

verses.original: ਮਾਟੀ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਧੋਪੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਾਣਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਏਹੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: maaTee kaa kiaa dhopai suaamee maanas kee gat ehee ||1||
verses.translation: How can dust be washed? O my Lord and Master, such is the state of mankind. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: mere man satigur sev sukh hoiee ||
verses.translation: O my mind, serve the True Guru, and be at peace.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਛਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jo ichhahu soiee fal paavahu fir dhookh na viaapai koiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Whatever you desire, you shall receive that reward, and you shall not be afflicted by pain any longer. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਾਚੇ ਭਾਡੇ ਸਾਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaache bhaadde saaj nivaaje a(n)tar jot samaiee ||
verses.translation: He creates and adorns the earthen vessels; He infuses His Light within them.

verses.original: ਜੈਸਾ ਲਿਖਤੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਹਮ ਤੈਸੀ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jaisaa likhat likhiaa dhur karatai ham taisee kirat kamaiee ||2||
verses.translation: As is the destiny pre-ordained by the Creator, so are the deeds we do. ||2||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਥਾਪਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਏਹੋ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: man tan thaap keeaa sabh apanaa eho aavan jaanaa ||
verses.translation: He believes the mind and body are all his own; this is the cause of his coming and going.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਸੋ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਮੋਹਿ ਅੰਧੁ ਲਪਟਾਣਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jin dheeaa so chit na aavai moh a(n)dh lapaTaanaa ||3||
verses.translation: He does not think of the One who gave him these; he is blind, entangled in emotional attachment. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਸੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin keeaa soiee prabh jaanai har kaa mahal apaaraa ||
verses.translation: One who knows that God created him, reaches the Incomparable Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhagat karee har ke gun gaavaa naanak dhaas tumaaraa ||4||1||
verses.translation: Worshipping the Lord, I sing His Glorious Praises. Nanak is Your slave. ||4||1||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਪਵਹੁ ਚਰਣਾ ਤਲਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਆਵਹੁ ਐਸੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: pavahu charanaa tal uoopar aavahu aaisee sev kamaavahu ||
verses.translation: Place yourself beneath all men's feet, and you will be uplifted; serve Him in this way.

verses.original: ਆਪਸ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਭ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਤਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aapas te uoopar sabh jaanahu tau dharageh sukh paavahu ||1||
verses.translation: Know that all are above you, and you shall find peace in the Court of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਐਸੀ ਕਥਹੁ ਕਹਾਣੀ ॥ ਸੁਰ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)tahu aaisee kathahu kahaanee || sur pavitr nar dhev pavitraa khin bolahu gurmukh baanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Saints, speak that speech which purifies the gods and sanctifies the divine beings. As Gurmukh, chant the Word of His Bani, even for an instant. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਰਪੰਚੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਹਜ ਘਰਿ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: parapa(n)ch chhodd sahaj ghar baisahu jhooThaa kahahu na koiee ||
verses.translation: Renounce your fraudulent plans, and dwell in the celestial palace; do not call anyone else false.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਨਵੈ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਲੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: satigur milahu navai nidh paavahu in bidh tat biloiee ||2||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, you shall receive the nine treasures; in this way, you shall find the essence of reality. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bharam chukaavahu gurmukh liv laavahu aatam cheenahu bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Eradicate doubt, and as Gurmukh, enshrine love for the Lord; understand your own soul, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਾਜਰੁ ਕਿਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੁਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: nikaT kar jaanahu sadhaa prabh haajar kis siau karahu buraiee ||3||
verses.translation: Know that God is near at hand, and ever-present. How could you try to hurt anyone else? ||3||

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: satigur miliaai maarag mukataa sahaje mile suaamee ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, your path shall be clear, and you shall easily meet your Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜਿਨੀ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan se jan jinee kal meh har paiaa jan naanak sadh kurabaanee ||4||2||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed are those humble beings, who, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, find the Lord. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||2||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਵਤ ਹਰਖ ਨ ਜਾਵਤ ਦੂਖਾ ਨਹ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਮਨ ਰੋਗਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: aavat harakh na jaavat dhookhaa neh biaapai man roganee ||
verses.translation: Coming does not please me, and going does not bring me pain, and so my mind is not afflicted by disease.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਉ ਉਤਰੀ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਓਗਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ana(n)dh gur pooraa paiaa tau utaree sagal bioganee ||1||
verses.translation: I am in bliss forever, for I have found the Perfect Guru; my separation from the Lord is totally ended. ||1||
This is how I have joined my mind to the Lord.

verses.original: ਮੋਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਲੋਗੁ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: moh sog rog log na biaapai teh har har har ras bhoganee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Attachment, sorrow, disease and public opinion do not affect me, and so, I enjoy the subtle essence of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੁਰਗ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਮਿਰਤ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਪਇਆਲ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਲੋਗਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: surag pavitraa mirat pavitraa piaal pavitr aloganee ||
verses.translation: I am pure in the heavenly realm, pure on this earth, and pure in the nether regions of the underworld. I remain apart from the people of the world.

verses.original: ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਭੁੰਚੈ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aagiaakaaree sadhaa sukh bhu(n)chai jat kat pekhau har gunee ||2||
verses.translation: Obedient to the Lord, I enjoy peace forever; wherever I look, I see the Lord of glorious virtues. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਹ ਸਿਵ ਸਕਤੀ ਜਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਵਨਾ ਤਹ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੇਦਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: neh siv sakatee jal nahee pavanaa teh akaar nahee medhanee ||
verses.translation: There is no Shiva or Shakti, no energy or matter, no water or wind, no world of form there,

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਜੋਗ ਕਾ ਤਹਾ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਜਹ ਅਵਿਗਤ ਨਾਥੁ ਅਗਮ ਧਨੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: satigur jog kaa tahaa nivaasaa jeh avigat naath agam dhanee ||3||
verses.translation: where the True Guru, the Yogi, dwells, where the Imperishable Lord God, the Unapproachable Master abides. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਗਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: tan man har kaa dhan sabh har kaa har ke gun hau kiaa ganee ||
verses.translation: Body and mind belong to the Lord; all wealth belongs to the Lord; what glorious virtues of the Lord can I describe?

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਈ ਹੈ ਅੰਭੈ ਅੰਭੁ ਮਿਲੋਗਨੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak ham tum gur khoiee hai a(n)bhai a(n)bh miloganee ||4||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, the Guru has destroyed my sense of 'mine and yours'. Like water with water, I am blended with God. ||4||3||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਰਹਤ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: trai gun rahat rahai niraaree saadhik sidh na jaanai ||
verses.translation: It is beyond the three qualities; it remains untouched. The seekers and Siddhas do not know it.

verses.original: ਰਤਨ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਖਜਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ratan koThaRee a(n)mirat sa(n)pooran satigur kai khajaanai ||1||
verses.translation: There is a chamber filled with jewels, overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar, in the Guru's Treasury. ||1||
This thing is wonderful and amazing! It cannot be described.
It is an unfathomable object, O Siblings of Destiny! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮੋਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਕਰਣੈ ਜੋਗਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: mol naahee kachh karanai jogaa kiaa ko kahai sunaavai ||
verses.translation: Its value cannot be estimated at all; what can anyone say about it?

verses.original: ਕਥਨ ਕਹਣ ਕਉ ਸੋਝੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੋ ਪੇਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kathan kahan kau sojhee naahee jo pekhai tis ban aavai ||2||
verses.translation: By speaking and describing it, it cannot be understood; only one who sees it realizes it. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਬੇਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: soiee jaanai karanaihaaraa keetaa kiaa bechaaraa ||
verses.translation: Only the Creator Lord knows it; what can any poor creature do?

verses.original: ਆਪਣੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਪੂਰ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: aapanee gat mit aape jaanai har aape poor bha(n)ddaaraa ||3||
verses.translation: Only He Himself knows His own state and extent. The Lord Himself is the treasure overflowing. ||3||

verses.original: ਐਸਾ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਨਿ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਰਹੇ ਆਘਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: aaisaa ras a(n)mrit man chaakhiaa tirapat rahe aaghaiee ||
verses.translation: Tasting such Ambrosial Nectar, the mind remains satisfied and satiated.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਰੀ ਆਸਾ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak meree aasaa pooree satigur kee saranaiee ||4||4||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, my hopes are fulfilled; I have found the Guru's Sanctuary. ||4||4||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਬੈਰੀ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)geekaar keeaa prabh apanai bairee sagale saadhe ||
verses.translation: God has made me His own, and vanquished all my enemies.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਬੈਰੀ ਹੈ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਟਿਆ ਤੇ ਬੈਰੀ ਲੈ ਬਾਧੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jin bairee hai ih jag looTiaa te bairee lai baadhe ||1||
verses.translation: Those enemies who have plundered this world, have all been placed in bondage. ||1||
The True Guru is my Transcendent Lord.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਰਾਜ ਭੋਗ ਰਸ ਮਾਣੀ ਨਾਉ ਜਪੀ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anik raaj bhog ras maanee naau japee bharavaasaa teraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I enjoy countless pleasures of power and tasty delights, chanting Your Name, and placing my faith in You. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਸਿ ਦੂਜੀ ਬਾਤਾ ਸਿਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: cheet na aavas dhoojee baataa sir uoopar rakhavaaraa ||
verses.translation: I do not think of any other at all. The Lord is my protector, above my head.

verses.original: ਬੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਰਹਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਕ ਨਾਮ ਕੈ ਆਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: beparavaahu rahat hai suaamee ik naam kai aadhaaraa ||2||
verses.translation: I am carefree and independent, when I have the Support of Your Name, O my Lord and Master. ||2||

verses.original: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਊਨ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: pooran hoi milio sukhadhaiee uoon na kaiee baataa ||
verses.translation: I have become perfect, meeting with the Giver of peace, and now, I lack nothing at all.

verses.original: ਤਤੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਛੋਡਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tat saar param padh paiaa chhodd na katahoo jaataa ||3||
verses.translation: I have obtained the essence of excellence, the supreme status; I shall not forsake it to go anywhere else. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਜੈਸਾ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: baran na saakau jaisaa too hai saache alakh apaaraa ||
verses.translation: I cannot describe how You are, O True Lord, unseen, infinite,

verses.original: ਅਤੁਲ ਅਥਾਹ ਅਡੋਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਖਸਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: atul athaeh addol suaamee naanak khasam hamaaraa ||4||5||
verses.translation: immeasurable, unfathomable and unmoving Lord. O Nanak, He is my Lord and Master. ||4||5||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤੂ ਦਾਨਾ ਤੂ ਅਬਿਚਲੁ ਤੂਹੀ ਤੂ ਜਾਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪਾਤੀ ॥
verses.translit: too dhaanaa too abichal toohee too jaat meree paatee ||
verses.translation: You are wise; You are eternal and unchanging. You are my social class and honor.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਅਡੋਲੁ ਕਦੇ ਡੋਲਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤਾ ਹਮ ਕੈਸੀ ਤਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: too addol kadhe ddoleh naahee taa ham kaisee taatee ||1||
verses.translation: You are unmoving - You never move at all. How can I be worried? ||1||
You alone are the One and only Lord;
You alone are the king.

verses.original: ਤਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tau kirapaa te sukh paiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By Your Grace, I have found peace. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਹਮ ਹੰਸ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: too saagar ham ha(n)s tumaare tum meh maanak laalaa ||
verses.translation: You are the ocean, and I am Your swan; the pearls and rubies are in You.

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਸੰਕ ਨ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਹਮ ਭੁੰਚਹ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tum dhevahu til sa(n)k na maanahu ham bhu(n)cheh sadhaa nihaalaa ||2||
verses.translation: You give, and You do not hesitate for an instant; I receive, forever enraptured. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮ ਪਿਤਾ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਤੁਮ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਖੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ham baarik tum pitaa hamaare tum mukh dhevahu kheeraa ||
verses.translation: I am Your child, and You are my father; You place the milk in my mouth.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਖੇਲਹ ਸਭਿ ਲਾਡ ਲਡਾਵਹ ਤੁਮ ਸਦ ਗੁਣੀ ਗਹੀਰਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ham kheleh sabh laadd laddaaveh tum sadh gunee gaheeraa ||3||
verses.translation: I play with You, and You caress me in every way. You are forever the ocean of excellence. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੁਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਹਮ ਭੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਅਘਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: tum pooran poor rahe sa(n)pooran ham bhee sa(n)g aghaae ||
verses.translation: You are perfect, perfectly all-pervading; I am fulfilled with You as well.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਤ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਿਲਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: milat milat milat mil rahiaa naanak kahan na jaae ||4||6||
verses.translation: I am merged, merged, merged and remain merged; O Nanak, I cannot describe it! ||4||6||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਤਾਲ ਪਖਾਵਜੁ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਮਾਥੈ ਵਜਹਿ ਰਬਾਬਾ ॥
verses.translit: kar kar taal pakhaavaj nainahu maathai vajeh rabaabaa ||
verses.translation: Make your hands the cymbals, your eyes the tambourines, and your forehead the guitar you play.

verses.original: ਕਰਨਹੁ ਮਧੁ ਬਾਸੁਰੀ ਬਾਜੈ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਆਗਾਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: karanahu madh baasuree baajai jihavaa dhun aagaajaa ||
verses.translation: Let the sweet flute music resound in your ears, and with your tongue, vibrate this song.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਨਾਚੈ ਆਣੇ ਘੂਘਰ ਸਾਜਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: nirat kare kar manooaa naachai aane ghooghar saajaa ||1||
verses.translation: Move your mind like the rhythmic hand-motions; do the dance, and shake your ankle bracelets. ||1||
This is the rhythmic dance of the Lord.

verses.original: ਪੇਖੈ ਪੇਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਜੇਤਾ ਸਾਜੁ ਸੀਗਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: pekhai pekhanahaar dhiaalaa jetaa saaj seegaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Merciful Audience, the Lord, sees all your make-up and decorations. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਖਾਰ ਮੰਡਲੀ ਧਰਣਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਊਪਰਿ ਗਗਨੁ ਚੰਦੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: aakhaar ma(n)ddalee dharan sabaiee uoopar gagan cha(n)dhoaa ||
verses.translation: The whole earth is the stage, with the canopy of the sky overhead.

verses.original: ਪਵਨੁ ਵਿਚੋਲਾ ਕਰਤ ਇਕੇਲਾ ਜਲ ਤੇ ਓਪਤਿ ਹੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: pavan vicholaa karat ikelaa jal te opat hoaa ||
verses.translation: The wind is the director; people are born of water.

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਤਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੁਤਰਾ ਕੀਨਾ ਕਿਰਤ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch tat kar putaraa keenaa kirat milaavaa hoaa ||2||
verses.translation: From the five elements, the puppet was created with its actions. ||2||

verses.original: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਜਰੇ ਚਰਾਗਾ ਚਹੁ ਕੁੰਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dh sooraj dhui jare charaagaa chahu ku(n)T bheetar raakhe ||
verses.translation: The sun and the moon are the two lamps which shine, with the four corners of the world placed between them.

verses.original: ਦਸ ਪਾਤਉ ਪੰਚ ਸੰਗੀਤਾ ਏਕੈ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਾਥੇ ॥
verses.translit: dhas paatau pa(n)ch sa(n)geetaa ekai bheetar saathe ||
verses.translation: The ten senses are the dancing girls, and the five passions are the chorus; they sit together within the one body.

verses.original: ਭਿੰਨ ਭਿੰਨ ਹੋਇ ਭਾਵ ਦਿਖਾਵਹਿ ਸਭਹੁ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ਭਾਖੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bhi(n)n bhi(n)n hoi bhaav dhikhaaveh sabhahu niraaree bhaakhe ||3||
verses.translation: They all put on their own shows, and speak in different languages. ||3||

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਨਿਰਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਵਾਜੈ ਤੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ghar nirat hovai dhin raatee ghaT ghaT vaajai tooraa ||
verses.translation: In each and every home there is dancing, day and night; in each and every home, the bugles blow.

verses.original: ਏਕਿ ਨਚਾਵਹਿ ਏਕਿ ਭਵਾਵਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਆਇ ਜਾਇ ਹੋਇ ਧੂਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: ek nachaaveh ek bhavaaveh ik aai jai hoi dhooraa ||
verses.translation: Some are made to dance, and some are whirled around; some come and some go, and some are reduced to dust.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਨਾਚੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੪॥੭॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak so bahur na naachai jis gur bheTai pooraa ||4||7||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, one who meets with the True Guru, does not have to dance the dance of reincarnation again. ||4||7||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਏਕ ਧੁਨਿ ਏਕੈ ਏਕੈ ਰਾਗੁ ਅਲਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: oa(n)kaar ek dhun ekai ekai raag alaapai ||
verses.translation: He sings the song of the One Universal Creator; he sings the tune of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਏਕਾ ਦੇਸੀ ਏਕੁ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ਏਕੋ ਰਹਿਆ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: ekaa dhesee ek dhikhaavai eko rahiaa biaapai ||
verses.translation: He lives in the land of the One Lord, shows the way to the One Lord, and remains attuned to the One Lord.

verses.original: ਏਕਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਏਕਾ ਹੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਏਕੋ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਪੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ekaa surat ekaa hee sevaa eko gur te jaapai ||1||
verses.translation: He centers his consciousness on the One Lord, and serves only the One Lord, who is known through the Guru. ||1||
Blessed and good is such a kirtanee, who sings such Praises.
He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord,

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਧੰਧ ਸੁਆਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chhodd maiaa ke dha(n)dh suaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and renounces the entanglements and pursuits of Maya. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਬਜਿਤ੍ਰ ਕਰੇ ਸੰਤੋਖਾ ਸਾਤ ਸੁਰਾ ਲੈ ਚਾਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch bajitr kare sa(n)tokhaa saat suraa lai chaalai ||
verses.translation: He makes the five virtues, like contentment, his musical instruments, and plays the seven notes of the love of the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਾਜਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਤਾਣੁ ਤਜਿ ਤਾਨਾ ਪਾਉ ਨ ਬੀਗਾ ਘਾਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: baajaa maan taan taj taanaa paau na beegaa ghaalai ||
verses.translation: The notes he plays are the renunciation of pride and power; his feet keep the beat on the straight path.

verses.original: ਫੇਰੀ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਾਲੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: feree fer na hovai kab hee ek sabadh ba(n)dh paalai ||2||
verses.translation: He does not enter the cycle of reincarnation ever again; he keeps the One Word of the Shabad tied to the hem of his robe. ||2||
To play like Naarad, is to know that the Lord is ever-present.
The tinkling of the ankle bells is the shedding of sorrows and worries.
The dramatic gestures of acting are celestial bliss.
Such a dancer is not reincarnated again. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਅਪਨੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ ॥ ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧਿ ਏਹੁ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: je ko apane Thaakur bhaavai || koT madh eh keeratan gaavai ||
verses.translation: If anyone, out of millions of people, becomes pleasing to his Lord and Master, he sings the Lord's Praises in this way.
I have taken the Support of the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
Says Nanak, the Kirtan of the One Lord's Praises are sung there. ||4||8||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਬੋਲੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਕੋਈ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: koiee bolai raam raam koiee khudhai ||
verses.translation: Some call Him, 'Raam, Raam', and some call Him, 'Khudaa-i'.
Some serve Him as 'Gusain', others as 'Allaah'. ||1||
He is the Cause of causes, the Generous Lord.
He showers His Grace and Mercy upon us. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਨਾਵੈ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਕੋਈ ਹਜ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: koiee naavai teerath koiee haj jai ||
verses.translation: Some bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and some make the pilgrimage to Mecca.|

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਪੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਿਵਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: koiee karai poojaa koiee sir nivai ||2||
verses.translation: Some perform devotional worship services, and some bow their heads in prayer. ||2||
Some read the Vedas, and some the Koran.
Some wear blue robes, and some wear white. ||3||

verses.original: ਕੋਈ ਕਹੈ ਤੁਰਕੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਹੈ ਹਿੰਦੂ ॥
verses.translit: koiee kahai turak koiee kahai hi(n)dhoo ||
verses.translation: Some call themselves Muslim, and some call themselves Hindu.
Some yearn for paradise, and others long for heaven. ||4||
Says Nanak, one who realizes the Hukam of God's Will,

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕਾ ਤਿਨਿ ਭੇਦੁ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੫॥੯॥
verses.translit: prabh saahib kaa tin bhedh jaataa ||5||9||
verses.translation: knows the secrets of his Lord and Master. ||5||9||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
The wind (the final breath) merges into the wind.
The light of the soul blends into the Light of the Creator.
The body's dust becomes one with the earthly dust.
What support is there for the one who is lamenting? ||1||
Who has died? O, who has died?

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ਇਹੁ ਤਉ ਚਲਤੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: braham giaanee mil karahu beechaaraa ih tau chalat bhiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O God-realized beings, meet together and consider this. What a wondrous thing has happened! ||1||Pause||
No one knows what happens after death.
The one who is lamenting will also arise and depart.
Mortal beings are bound by the bonds of doubt and attachment.
When life becomes a dream, the blind man (in the attachment of the illusionary world of desires) babbles and grieves in vain. ||2||
The Creator Lord created this creation.
It comes and goes, subject to the Will of the Infinite Lord.

verses.original: ਨਹ ਕੋ ਮੂਆ ਨ ਮਰਣੈ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: neh ko mooaa na maranai jog ||
verses.translation: No one dies; no one is capable of dying.
The soul does not perish; it is imperishable. ||3||

verses.original: ਜੋ ਇਹੁ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਸੋ ਇਹੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jo ih jaanahu so ih naeh ||
verses.translation: What one perceives this(live soul) to be, it actually is not
I am a sacrifice to the one who knows this.
Says Nanak, the Guru has dispelled my doubt.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਕੋਈ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: naa koiee marai na aavai jaiaa ||4||10||
verses.translation: No one dies; no one comes or goes. ||4||10||
Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla:
Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Beloved Lord of the World.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਤੂ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਖਾਈ ਮਹਾ ਕਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam simar too jeeveh fir na khaiee mahaa kaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord's Name, you shall live, and the Great Death shall not consume you ever again. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਇਓ ॥
verses.translit: koT janam bhram bhram bhram aaio ||
verses.translation: Through millions of incarnations, you have come, wandering, wandering, wandering.
By the highest destiny, you found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||
Without the Perfect Guru, no one is saved.
This is what Baba Nanak says, after deep reflection. ||2||11||

verses.translit: raag raamakalee mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Raag Raamkalee, Fifth Mehla, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The four Vedas proclaim it, but you don't believe them.
The six Shaastras also say one thing.
The eighteen Puraanas all speak of the One God.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਭੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: taa bhee jogee bhedh na lahiaa ||1||
verses.translation: Even so, Yogi, you do not understand this mystery. ||1||
The celestial harp plays the incomparable melody,
but in your intoxication, you do not hear it, O Yogi. ||1||Pause||
In the first age, the Golden Age, the village of truth was inhabited.
In the Silver Age of Traytaa Yuga, things began to decline.
In the Brass Age of Dwaapur Yuga, half of it was gone.
Now, only one leg of Truth remains, and the One Lord is revealed. ||2||
